instruction: List all Amara taxons with their corresponding Wikispecies articles.
annotated:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT ?q ?article {
?q wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:taxon] ; rdfs:label 'Amara'@en .

}

instruction: Find publications associated with an author using their ORCID iD.
annotated:

PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT distinct ?work ?workLabel ?typeLabel
WHERE {
?person wdt:[property:ORCID iD] ?orcid . # person has an ORCID
Values ?orcid { "0000-0001-5882-6823" }. # ...and the ORCID is...
?work wdt:[property:author] ?person . # a work has this person as author
?work wdt:[property:instance of] ?type . # what type is the work?

}

SELECT ?l ?sense ?lemma ?languageLabel WHERE {

List all places in Antarctica that are more than 3000 kilometers north of the South Pole.
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?place ?placeLabel ?location WHERE {
wd:[entity:South Pole] wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?southPole. # coordinates of south pole

SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}

instruction: What are the most common eye colors among humans?
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?eyeColor ?eyeColorLabel ?rgb (COUNT(?human) AS ?count)
WHERE
{
?human wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human].
?human wdt:[property:eye color] ?eyeColor.
OPTIONAL { ?eyeColor wdt:[property:sRGB color hex triplet] ?rgb. }
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}
GROUP BY ?eyeColor ?eyeColorLabel ?rgb
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

Find French writers born between 1751 and 1800 who have a pseudonym or an English label.
annotated:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT ?writer ?label
WHERE
{
# French writer born in the second half of the 18th century
?writer wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human];
wdt:[property:country of citizenship] wd:[entity:France];
wdt:[property:occupation] wd:[entity:writer];
wdt:[property:date of birth] ?dob.
FILTER("1751-01-01"^^xsd:dateTime <= ?dob && ?dob < "1801-01-01"^^xsd:dateTime).
# get the English label
?writer rdfs:label ?writerLabel.
FILTER(LANG(?writerLabel) = "en").
# get the pseudonym, if it exists
OPTIONAL { ?writer wdt:[property:pseudonym] ?pseudonym. }
# bind the pseudonym, or if it doesn't exist the English label, as ?label
BIND(IF(BOUND(?pseudonym),?pseudonym,?writerLabel) AS ?label).
}

instruction: List all metro stations with their coordinates.
Find all senses of a word that share the same definition in at least one language.
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

select ?i ?lemma ?langLabel ?sense1 ?sense2 ?gloss {
?i dct:language ?lang ; wikibase:lemma ?lemma ; ontolex:sense ?sense1, ?sense2 .
?gloss ^skos:definition ?sense1, ?sense2 .
FILTER(STR(?sense1) < STR(?sense2))
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}

instruction: List all programming paradigms along with the number of languages that support them.
List the awards won by female alumni of the University of Edinburgh.
What is the longest English word that does not have any repeated letters?
query:
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> # workaround for T233148
SELECT ?lexeme ?lemma (STRLEN(?lemma) AS ?length) WHERE {
BIND(wd:Q1860 AS ?language)
?lexeme dct:language ?language;
wikibase:lemma ?lemma.
FILTER(STRLEN(?lemma) >= 10) # cheap filter to avoid running REGEX() on too many lemmata
FILTER(!REGEX(LCASE(?lemma), "(.).*\\1"))
FILTER(!CONTAINS(?lemma, " "))
}
ORDER BY DESC(?length)
LIMIT 10
annotated:
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> # workaround for T233148
SELECT ?lexeme ?lemma (STRLEN(?lemma) AS ?length) WHERE {
BIND(wd:[entity:English] AS ?language)
?lexeme dct:language ?language;
wikibase:lemma ?lemma.
FILTER(STRLEN(?lemma) >= 10) # cheap filter to avoid running REGEX() on too many lemmata
FILTER(!REGEX(LCASE(?lemma), "(.).*\\1"))
FILTER(!CONTAINS(?lemma, " "))
}
ORDER BY DESC(?length)
LIMIT 10

instruction: What events started in 2017 and ended in 2018?
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?start ?end ?durationInDays WHERE {
?item wdt:[property:instance of]/wdt:[property:subclass of]* wd:[entity:event];
p:[property:start time]/psv:[property:start time] [ wikibase:timeValue ?start; wikibase:timePrecision ?startPrecision ];
p:[property:end time]/psv:[property:end time] [ wikibase:timeValue ?end; wikibase:timePrecision ?endPrecision ].
FILTER("2017-01-01"^^xsd:dateTime <= ?start && ?start < "2018-01-01"^^xsd:dateTime)
FILTER("2018-01-01"^^xsd:dateTime <= ?end && ?end < "2019-01-01"^^xsd:dateTime)
FILTER(?startPrecision >= 10 && ?endPrecision >= 10) # precision 10 = month
BIND(?end - ?start AS ?durationInDays)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en,fr". }
}
ORDER BY ASC(?durationInDays)

query:

WHERE
{
?street wdt:P31 wd:Q79007.
?street wdt:P131 wd:Q43631 .
?street wdt:P138 ?namedafter .
?street wdt:P625 ?coords .

instruction: Show me a list of space probes with their launch dates and pictures.
What are the names of EDM artists who released albums before 1980?
query:
SELECT ?artistName ?albumTitle ?releaseDate
WHERE {
?artist wdt:P136 wd:Q851213 ; # artist has genre of EDM
rdfs:label ?artistName .
FILTER ( lang(?artistName) = "en" )
?album wdt:P31 wd:Q482994 .
?album wdt:P175 ?artist ; # album has performer
rdfs:label ?albumTitle ;
p:P577 ?releaseDateThing .# release date as (claim about the date?)
?releaseDateThing ps:P577 ?releaseDate . # release date as ISO 8601
FILTER (?releaseDate < "1980-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime)
FILTER ( lang(?albumTitle) = "en" )
}
annotated:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT ?artistName ?albumTitle ?releaseDate
WHERE {
?artist wdt:[property:genre] wd:[entity:electronic dance music] ; # artist has genre of EDM
rdfs:label ?artistName .
FILTER ( lang(?artistName) = "en" )
?album wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:album] .
?album wdt:[property:performer] ?artist ; # album has performer
rdfs:label ?albumTitle ;
p:[property:publication date] ?releaseDateThing .# release date as (claim about the date?)
?releaseDateThing ps:[property:publication date] ?releaseDate . # release date as ISO 8601
FILTER (?releaseDate < "1980-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime)
FILTER ( lang(?albumTitle) = "en" )
}

annotated:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?name WHERE {
?sub wdt:[property:subclass of]+/rdfs:label "coin"@en.
{?sub rdfs:label ?name} UNION {?sub skos:altLabel ?name} FILTER (lang(?name)="en")
FILTER ( !CONTAINS(?name, "coin") )
}

instruction: List all French communes with names starting with 'Saint'.
query:
SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?label ?coord
WHERE
{
?item wdt:P17 wd:Q142 .
?item wdt:P31 wd:Q484170.
?item wdt:P625 ?coord .
?item rdfs:label ?labelWithLanguage.
FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?labelWithLanguage)), "saint"))
FILTER(LANG(?labelWithLanguage) = "fr")

instruction: List all individuals with a CBDB ID but no country information.
List all recipes that have garlic as an ingredient.
List all people born in 1606 with the same occupation.
query:
select distinct ?person1 ?person2 ?Label ?birthday ?occupation where
{
?person1 wdt:P569 ?birthday . ?person2 wdt:P569 ?birthday .
filter (?birthday >= "1706-01-01"^^xsd:dateTime) . filter (?birthday < "1707-01-01"^^xsd:dateTime) .
?person1 rdfs:label ?Label . filter(lang(?Label) = "en") .
?person2 rdfs:label ?Label .
?person1 wdt:P106 ?occ . ?person2 wdt:P106 ?occ .
?occ rdfs:label ?occupation . filter(lang(?occupation) = "en") .
filter (str(?person1) > str(?person2))
}
annotated:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

select distinct ?person1 ?person2 ?Label ?birthday ?occupation where
{
?person1 wdt:[property:date of birth] ?birthday . ?person2 wdt:[property:date of birth] ?birthday .
filter (?birthday >= "1706-01-01"^^xsd:dateTime) . filter (?birthday < "1707-01-01"^^xsd:dateTime) .
?person1 rdfs:label ?Label . filter(lang(?Label) = "en") .
?person2 rdfs:label ?Label .
?person1 wdt:[property:occupation] ?occ . ?person2 wdt:[property:occupation] ?occ .
?occ rdfs:label ?occupation . filter(lang(?occupation) = "en") .
filter (str(?person1) > str(?person2))
}

instruction: List all humans who died in 2016.

instruction: List all plant genera depicted in Flora Graeca.

?art wdt:P180 ?species. # Artwork depicts species
?species wdt:P171 ?genus. # parent taxon of species
?genus wdt:P225 ?genusname. # taxon name of genus
} GROUP BY ?genus ?genusname
ORDER BY ?genusname
annotated:
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>

?art wdt:[property:published in] wd:[entity:Flora Graeca]. # Artwork published in FG
?art wdt:[property:depicts] ?species. # Artwork depicts species
?species wdt:[property:parent taxon] ?genus. # parent taxon of species
?genus wdt:[property:taxon name] ?genusname. # taxon name of genus
} GROUP BY ?genus ?genusname
ORDER BY ?genusname

SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?itemDescription ?enwp ?eswp WHERE {
?item wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human] . # Human beings

instruction: Find the coordinates of places in Paris.

instruction: Show me a graph of British monarchs and their prime ministers.
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?pm ?pmLabel ?pmImage ?monarch ?monarchLabel ?monarchImage WITH {
# not sure if there is a more straightforward way to access British monarchs (this query runs second)
SELECT DISTINCT ?monarch ?monarch_start ?monarch_end WHERE {
INCLUDE %start_UK .
VALUES $MONARCH { wd:[entity:Monarch of Great Britain] wd:[entity:monarch of the United Kingdom] wd:[entity:monarch of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland] }
?monarch wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human] .
?monarch p:[property:position held] ?ph .
?ph ps:[property:position held] $MONARCH .
?ph pq:[property:start time] ?monarch_start .
OPTIONAL { ?ph pq:[property:end time] ?monarch_end }
FILTER (?monarch_start >= ?start_UK || ?monarch_end >= ?start_UK)
BIND ( NOW() AS ?today )
BIND(COALESCE(?monarch_end, ?today) as ?monarch_end) # handle missing end dates, hopefully it's just the current monarch
} } AS %monarchs
# Find the start date of the first Prime Minister so we can filter monarchs that reigned after this point (this query runs first)
WITH { SELECT ?start_UK WHERE {
?pm p:[property:position held] ?pmph_stmt .
?pmph_stmt ps:[property:position held] wd:[entity:Prime Minister of the United Kingdom] .
?pmph_stmt pq:[property:start time] ?start_UK .
}
ORDER BY ?start_UK
LIMIT 1 } AS %start_UK
# this query runs last and uses the select in line 2; it produces the visualisation specified in line 1
WHERE {
INCLUDE %monarchs
?pm wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human] .
?pm p:[property:position held] ?node .
?node ps:[property:position held] wd:[entity:Prime Minister of the United Kingdom] .
OPTIONAL { ?node pq:[property:start time] ?pm_start }
OPTIONAL { ?node pq:[property:end time] ?pm_end }
BIND ( NOW() AS ?today )
BIND(COALESCE(?pm_end, ?today) as ?pm_end) # handle missing end dates, hopefully it's just the current president
FILTER( (?monarch_start >= ?pm_start && ?monarch_start <= ?pm_end) || (?monarch_end >= ?pm_start && ?monarch_end <= ?pm_end ) ||
(?pm_start >= ?monarch_start && ?pm_start <= ?monarch_end) || (?pm_end >= ?monarch_start && ?pm_end <= ?monarch_end ))
# get images, use a default image if none found
OPTIONAL { ?monarch wdt:[property:image] ?monarchImage }
BIND(COALESCE(?monarchImage, <http://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Image_needed,_please_upload_to_commons.wikimedia.org.jpg>) as ?monarchImage)
OPTIONAL { ?pm wdt:[property:image] ?pmImage }
BIND(COALESCE(?pmImage, <http://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Image_needed,_please_upload_to_commons.wikimedia.org.jpg>) as ?pmImaage)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}

instruction: List all physical quantities with their defining formulas.
annotated:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

select
?quantity
(sample(?label) as ?label)
(sample(?desc) as ?desc)
(sample(?symbol) as ?symbol)
?formula
(
strdt(
concat(
"<math><mtable columnalign=left>",
group_concat(?symbolAndLabel),
"</mtable></math>"
),
<http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML>
) as ?otherSymbols
)
where {
?quantity wdt:[property:subclass of]+ wd:[entity:individual quantity] .
optional { ?quantity rdfs:label ?label . filter (lang(?label) = "en") }
optional { ?quantity schema:description ?desc . filter (lang(?desc) = "en") }
?quantity wdt:[property:defining formula] ?formula .
?quantity wdt:[property:in defining formula] ?symbol .
{
select distinct * where {
?quantity p:[property:calculated from] [ pq:[property:in defining formula] ?otherSymbol ; ps:[property:calculated from] / rdfs:label ?otherLabel ] .
filter (lang(?otherLabel) = "en")
bind (
concat(
"<mrow>",
str(?otherSymbol), "<mtext>", ": ", ?otherLabel, "</mtext>",
"</mrow>"
) as ?symbolAndLabel
)
}
}
}
group by ?quantity ?formula
limit 500

instruction: Find locations in Sweden with their coordinates and elevation above sea level.
query:
SELECT ?x ?xLabel ?description ?x_coords ?rgb WITH {
SELECT ?data ?x ?x_coords WHERE {
?x p:P2044/psn:P2044 [
wikibase:quantityAmount ?data
] .
?x wdt:P625 ?x_coords .
?x wdt:P17 wd:Q34 .
# ?x wdt:P131+ [ wdt:P31 wd:Q15979307 ] .
}
} AS %data
# determine the max and min values (used to calculate the spread)
WITH {
SELECT (MAX(?data) AS ?max_data) (MIN(?data) AS ?min_data) WHERE {
INCLUDE %data
}} AS %min_max
WHERE {
INCLUDE %data
INCLUDE %min_max
?x rdfs:label ?xLabel. FILTER (LANG(?xLabel) = "sv") .
BIND (CONCAT("Hojd over havsnivan for ", ?xLabel, " ar omkring ", STR(ROUND(?data)), " meter" ) AS ?description)
BIND ( ?max_data - ?min_data AS ?spread )
BIND (255 - xsd:integer( 255 * (?data - ?min_data) / ?spread) AS ?green ) # 255 -> 0
BIND ( FLOOR (?green / 16) AS ?green_1 )
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?green_1 < 10, STR(?green_1), 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 10, "a", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 11, "b", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 12, "c", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 13, "d", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?green_hex1 )
BIND (FLOOR(?green - (16 * xsd:integer( ?green / 16 ))) AS ?green_2)
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?green_2 < 10, STR(?green_2), 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 10, "a", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 11, "b", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 12, "c", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 13, "d", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?green_hex2 )
BIND (CONCAT(STR(?green_hex1), STR(?green_hex2)) AS ?green_hex )
BIND (CONCAT("00", STR(?green_hex), "00") AS ?rgb)
}
annotated:

PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?x ?xLabel ?description ?x_coords ?rgb WITH {
SELECT ?data ?x ?x_coords WHERE {
?x p:[property:elevation above sea level]/psn:[property:elevation above sea level] [
wikibase:quantityAmount ?data
] .
?x wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?x_coords .
?x wdt:[property:country] wd:[entity:Sweden] .
# ?x wdt:[property:located in the administrative territorial entity]+ [ wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:principal area of Wales] ] .
}
} AS %data
# determine the max and min values (used to calculate the spread)
WITH {

INCLUDE %data
}} AS %min_max
WHERE {
INCLUDE %data
INCLUDE %min_max
?x rdfs:label ?xLabel. FILTER (LANG(?xLabel) = "sv") .
BIND (CONCAT("Hojd over havsnivan for ", ?xLabel, " ar omkring ", STR(ROUND(?data)), " meter" ) AS ?description)
BIND ( ?max_data - ?min_data AS ?spread )
BIND (255 - xsd:integer( 255 * (?data - ?min_data) / ?spread) AS ?green ) # 255 -> 0
BIND ( FLOOR (?green / 16) AS ?green_1 )
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?green_1 < 10, STR(?green_1), 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 10, "a", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 11, "b", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 12, "c", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 13, "d", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?green_hex1 )
BIND (FLOOR(?green - (16 * xsd:integer( ?green / 16 ))) AS ?green_2)
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?green_2 < 10, STR(?green_2), 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 10, "a", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 11, "b", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 12, "c", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 13, "d", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?green_hex2 )

instruction: List the first letters of non-free software names.

instruction: Find texts that have links to both English and French Wikisources.

instruction: List the top servers with the most annotations according to Wikidata.
List the US states with the highest number of punk bands.
query:
SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT(?band)) AS ?bandCount)
(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?bandLabel; SEPARATOR=", ") AS ?bands)
WHERE {
?band p:P31 ?statement1.
?statement1 (ps:P31/(wdt:P279*)) wd:Q215380. # item is instance of musical group or subclass (ie. rock group)
?band p:P136 ?statement0.
?statement0 (ps:P136/(wdt:P279*)) wd:Q25554481. # band genre is punk music or subclass
?band wdt:P740 ?city. # band formed in city
?city wdt:P131* ?state. # county in admin body (state)
?state wdt:P31 wd:Q35657. # state is instance of US State
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en".
?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel.
?band rdfs:label ?bandLabel.}
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?bandCount)
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT(?band)) AS ?bandCount)
(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?bandLabel; SEPARATOR=", ") AS ?bands)
WHERE {
?band p:[property:instance of] ?statement1.
?statement1 (ps:[property:instance of]/(wdt:[property:subclass of]*)) wd:[entity:musical group]. # item is instance of musical group or subclass (ie. rock group)
?band p:[property:genre] ?statement0.
?statement0 (ps:[property:genre]/(wdt:[property:subclass of]*)) wd:[entity:punk music]. # band genre is punk music or subclass
?band wdt:[property:location of formation] ?city. # band formed in city

SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en".
?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel.
?band rdfs:label ?bandLabel.}

instruction: What is the most common day of the month for UK by-elections since 1880?
query:
select (concat(str(?day), "/", str(?month)) as ?date) (count(distinct ?ps) as ?count)
where {
?MP p:P39 ?ps . ?ps ps:P39 ?term . ?term wdt:P279 wd:Q16707842 .
?ps pq:P2715 ?election .
?ps pq:P580 ?elected .
?election wdt:P31* wd:Q7864918 .
bind(day(?elected) as ?day) . bind(month(?elected) as ?month) .
filter(year(?elected) >= 1880) .
} group by ?day ?month order by desc(?count)

PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>

PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

select (concat(str(?day), "/", str(?month)) as ?date) (count(distinct ?ps) as ?count)
where {
?MP p:[property:position held] ?ps . ?ps ps:[property:position held] ?term . ?term wdt:[property:subclass of] wd:[entity:Member of Parliament] .
?ps pq:[property:elected in] ?election .
?ps pq:[property:start time] ?elected .
?election wdt:[property:instance of]* wd:[entity:UK Parliamentary by-election] .
bind(day(?elected) as ?day) . bind(month(?elected) as ?month) .
filter(year(?elected) >= 1880) .
} group by ?day ?month order by desc(?count)

instruction: List the number of males and females mentioned in each article.
query:
SELECT
?article
(SUM(?male) AS ?count_males)
(SUM(?female) AS ?count_females)
(SUM(?nonbinary) AS ?count_nonbinary)
(COUNT(*) AS ?count)
(ROUND(100 * ?count_females / (?count_females + ?count_males + ?count_nonbinary)) AS ?share_females)
(ROUND(100 * ?count_nonbinary / (?count_females + ?count_males + ?count_nonbinary)) AS ?share_nonbinary)
(ROUND(100 * ?count_males / (?count_females + ?count_males + ?count_nonbinary)) AS ?share_males)
{
VALUES ?article {
"Anthropology"
"Philosophy"
"Economics"
"Sociology"
"Demography"
}
SERVICE wikibase:mwapi {
bd:serviceParam wikibase:endpoint "en.wikipedia.org";
wikibase:api "Generator";
mwapi:generator "links";
mwapi:titles ?article;.
?item wikibase:apiOutputItem mwapi:item.
}
FILTER BOUND (?item)
?item wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
?item wdt:P21 ?gender .
BIND(IF(?gender IN(wd:Q6581097, wd:Q2449503), 1, 0) AS ?male )
BIND(IF(?gender IN(wd:Q6581072, wd:Q1052281), 1, 0 ) AS ?female)
BIND(IF(?gender = wd:Q48270, 1, 0) AS ?nonbinary)
}
GROUP BY ?article

(SUM(?male) AS ?count_males)
(SUM(?female) AS ?count_females)
(SUM(?nonbinary) AS ?count_nonbinary)
(COUNT(*) AS ?count)
(ROUND(100 * ?count_females / (?count_females + ?count_males + ?count_nonbinary)) AS ?share_females)
(ROUND(100 * ?count_nonbinary / (?count_females + ?count_males + ?count_nonbinary)) AS ?share_nonbinary)
(ROUND(100 * ?count_males / (?count_females + ?count_males + ?count_nonbinary)) AS ?share_males)
{
VALUES ?article {
"Anthropology"
"Philosophy"
"Economics"
"Sociology"
"Demography"
}
SERVICE wikibase:mwapi {
bd:serviceParam wikibase:endpoint "en.wikipedia.org";
wikibase:api "Generator";
mwapi:generator "links";
mwapi:titles ?article;.
?item wikibase:apiOutputItem mwapi:item.
}
FILTER BOUND (?item)
?item wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human] .
?item wdt:[property:sex or gender] ?gender .
BIND(IF(?gender IN(wd:[entity:male], wd:[entity:trans man]), 1, 0) AS ?male )
BIND(IF(?gender IN(wd:[entity:female], wd:[entity:trans woman]), 1, 0 ) AS ?female)
BIND(IF(?gender = wd:[entity:non-binary], 1, 0) AS ?nonbinary)
}

What are some popular cocktails and their ingredients?
query:
SELECT ?cocktail ?cocktailLabel (GROUP_CONCAT(?ingredient; separator=", ") AS ?ingredients) # concatenate all ingredients together, separated by comma
WHERE
{
# find a cocktail
?cocktail wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q134768;
# get its material statement
p:P186 ?materialStat.
# get the statement value from the statement
?materialStat ps:P186 ?material.
# get the material's English label
?material rdfs:label ?materialLabel.
FILTER(LANG(?materialLabel) = "en").
# assign label to solo ingredient variable
BIND(?materialLabel AS ?ingredientSolo).
OPTIONAL {
# for some reason, we have to get the material and materialLabel again - copy+pasted from above
?materialStat ps:P186 ?material.
?material rdfs:label ?materialLabel.
FILTER(LANG(?materialLabel) = "en").
# get the quantity value from the statement (if present)
?materialStat pqv:P1114 ?quantityValue.
# get the actual quantity from the quantity value
?quantityValue wikibase:quantityAmount ?quantity.
# assign quantity and material to ingredient with quantity variable
BIND(CONCAT(STR(?quantity), " ", ?materialLabel) AS ?ingredientWithQuantity).
OPTIONAL {
# same here for material and quantity
?materialStat ps:P186 ?material.
?material rdfs:label ?materialLabel.
FILTER(LANG(?materialLabel) = "en").
?materialStat pqv:P1114 ?quantityValue.
?quantityValue wikibase:quantityAmount ?quantity.
# get the unit from the quantity value
?quantityValue wikibase:quantityUnit ?unit.
# throw out the unit "1" (no unit)
FILTER(?unit != wd:Q199).
# get the unit's English label
?unit rdfs:label ?unitLabel.
FILTER(LANG(?unitLabel) = "en").
# assign quantity, unit, and material to ingredient with unit variable (note: we're not bothering with pluralization here, so it may sound a bit weird)
BIND(CONCAT(STR(?quantity), " ", ?unitLabel, " ", ?materialLabel) AS ?ingredientWithUnit).
}
}
# assign ingredient with unit, else ingredient with quantity, else just solo ingredient to ingredient variable
BIND(COALESCE(?ingredientWithUnit, ?ingredientWithQuantity, ?ingredientSolo) AS ?ingredient).
# get the cocktail's English label
?cocktail rdfs:label ?cocktailLabel.
FILTER(LANG(?cocktailLabel) = "en").
}
# group by cocktail
GROUP BY ?cocktail ?cocktailLabel
# show most "complicated" cocktails first
ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(?ingredient))

instruction: List women who hold citizenship of a country and have the most articles in languages other than French.
List the directors who have worked with the same actor more than 20 times.
List the world's tallest mountains with their heights and climbing history.
query:
SELECT DISTINCT ?mountain ?mountainLabel (sample(?height) as ?height) (year(?date) as ?year) (sample(?location) as ?location) ?layer
WHERE
{
?mountain wdt:P31 wd:Q8502 . # Everything that's a mountain
?mountain wdt:P625 ?location . # and has a coordinate
?mountain p:P2044 ?heightstatement . # and has a height-statement
?heightstatement psv:P2044 ?PSVStatement. # normalised height statement
?PSVStatement wikibase:quantityNormalized ?another_statement .
?another_statement wikibase:quantityAmount ?height.# height - phew!
FILTER(?height > 6000) # only the tallest
OPTIONAL {
?mountain p:P793 ?event . # and within that "significant event" statement
?event ps:P793 wd:Q1194369 . # continued...
?event pq:P585 ?date . #it has a "point in time" qualifier statement.
bind ("Climbed" as ?layer) # this seems to be what we need to get colour labels -
# ie if it falls in the optional group of "was first summited"
# then bind to a new layer, otherwise no special layer
}
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}
group by ?mountain ?mountainLabel ?date ?layer
ORDER BY DESC (?height)
LIMIT 200

instruction: What is the count of items in Wikidata for each collection property?

List all minerals named after women.
Show me pictures of people from South East England who fought in World War I.
query:
SELECT DISTINCT ?image ?name (CONCAT("Born ",str(?born), "; Died ", str(?died)) as ?dates) ?birthplace ?article WHERE {
?person wdt:P19 ?place ; # place of birth
wdt:P607 wd:Q361 ; # involved in World War I
wdt:P18 ?image ; #image
wdt:P569 ?dob #date of birth
{?place wdt:P131* wd:Q48015 } UNION { ?place wdt:P131* ?county. ?county wdt:P47 wd:Q23169 } # born in SE England or adjacent county to Oxfordshire
OPTIONAL { ?person wdt:P570 ?dod } #date of death
BIND(YEAR(?dob) as ?born)
BIND(YEAR(?dod) as ?died)
?person rdfs:label ?name filter (lang(?name) = "en")
?place rdfs:label ?birthplace filter (lang(?birthplace) = "en")
OPTIONAL{ ?article schema:about ?person; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> }
}
annotated:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?image ?name (CONCAT("Born ",str(?born), "; Died ", str(?died)) as ?dates) ?birthplace ?article WHERE {
?person wdt:[property:place of birth] ?place ; # place of birth
wdt:[property:conflict] wd:[entity:World War I] ; # involved in World War I
wdt:[property:image] ?image ; #image
wdt:[property:date of birth] ?dob #date of birth
{?place wdt:[property:located in the administrative territorial entity]* wd:[entity:South East England] } UNION { ?place wdt:[property:located in the administrative territorial entity]* ?county. ?county wdt:[property:shares border with] wd:[entity:Oxfordshire] } # born in SE England or adjacent county to Oxfordshire
OPTIONAL { ?person wdt:[property:date of death] ?dod } #date of death
BIND(YEAR(?dob) as ?born)
BIND(YEAR(?dod) as ?died)
?person rdfs:label ?name filter (lang(?name) = "en")
?place rdfs:label ?birthplace filter (lang(?birthplace) = "en")
OPTIONAL{ ?article schema:about ?person; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> }
}

instruction: What are the major periods in Japanese history and what were they named after?
List all compositions that feature the organ along with other instruments.
List all railway stations in the UK with coordinates from English Wikipedia that have different coordinates.
query:
SELECT ?item ?title ?wd_coord ?wiki_coord ?dist
WITH
{
SELECT DISTINCT ?item
{
?item wdt:P31 / wdt:P279 * wd:Q55488 .
?item wdt:P17 wd:Q145 .
FILTER STRENDS(STR(?item), "0")
}
} AS %get_items
{
INCLUDE %get_items
?item p:P625 ?s .
?s ps:P625 ?wd_coord .
?s prov:wasDerivedFrom ?ref .
?ref pr:P143 wd:Q328 .
?sitelink schema:about ?item .
?sitelink schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> .
?sitelink schema:name ?title .
SERVICE wikibase:mwapi
{
bd:serviceParam wikibase:endpoint "en.wikipedia.org" .
bd:serviceParam wikibase:api "Generator" .
bd:serviceParam mwapi:generator "allpages" .
bd:serviceParam mwapi:gapfrom ?title .
bd:serviceParam mwapi:gapto ?title .
bd:serviceParam mwapi:prop "coordinates" .
?lat wikibase:apiOutput "coordinates/co/@lat" .
?lon wikibase:apiOutput "coordinates/co/@lon" .
}
BIND (STRDT(CONCAT("Point(", ?lon, " ", ?lat, ")"), geo:wktLiteral) AS ?wiki_coord)
BIND (geof:distance(?wd_coord, ?wiki_coord) AS ?dist)
FILTER (! BOUND(?dist) || ?dist > 0.0)
} ORDER BY DESC(?dist)

instruction: Show me a map of airports in India with their flight connections.
query:
SELECT DISTINCT ?cd ?l ?i ?iLabel ?ct ?ctLabel ?rgb ?x WITH{SELECT ?i ?cd ?lat1 ?lon1 ?x(sample(?op)as?op)WHERE{{?i wdt:P31 wd:Q1248784}UNION{?i wdt:P31 wd:Q644371}?i wdt:P625 ?cd;wdt:P17 wd:Q668;p:P625/psv:P625 ?y.?y wikibase:geoLatitude ?lat1;wikibase:geoLongitude ?lon1.OPTIONAL{?i wdt:P137 ?op}}GROUP BY ?i ?cd ?lat1 ?lon1 ?x}AS%s
WITH{SELECT ?l ?o ?t WHERE{INCLUDE %s.?i wdt:P17 wd:Q668;p:P521 ?nss.?nss ps:P521 ?ns.?ns wdt:P17 wd:Q668;p:P625/psv:P625 ?z.?z wikibase:geoLatitude ?lat2;wikibase:geoLongitude ?lon2.OPTIONAL{?nss pq:P137 ?o}FILTER(STR(?i)< STR(?ns)).BIND(CONCAT('LINESTRING(',STR(?lon1),' ',STR(?lat1),',',STR(?lon2),' ',STR(?lat2),')')AS?str).BIND(STRDT(?str,geo:wktLiteral)AS?l)}}AS%l
WHERE{{INCLUDE%s}UNION{INCLUDE%l}.BIND(IF(BOUND(?l),"f0f","007f00") as ?rgb)SERVICE wikibase:label{bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en".}}#
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?cd ?l ?i ?iLabel ?ct ?ctLabel ?rgb ?x WITH{SELECT ?i ?cd ?lat1 ?lon1 ?x(sample(?op)as?op)WHERE{{?i wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:airport]}UNION{?i wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:international airport]}?i wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?cd;wdt:[property:country] wd:[entity:India];p:[property:coordinate location]/psv:[property:coordinate location] ?y.?y wikibase:geoLatitude ?lat1;wikibase:geoLongitude ?lon1.OPTIONAL{?i wdt:[property:operator] ?op}}GROUP BY ?i ?cd ?lat1 ?lon1 ?x}AS%s
WITH{SELECT ?l ?o ?t WHERE{INCLUDE %s.?i wdt:[property:country] wd:[entity:India];p:[property:scheduled service destination] ?nss.?nss ps:[property:scheduled service destination] ?ns.?ns wdt:[property:country] wd:[entity:India];p:[property:coordinate location]/psv:[property:coordinate location] ?z.?z wikibase:geoLatitude ?lat2;wikibase:geoLongitude ?lon2.OPTIONAL{?nss pq:[property:operator] ?o}FILTER(STR(?i)< STR(?ns)).BIND(CONCAT('LINESTRING(',STR(?lon1),' ',STR(?lat1),',',STR(?lon2),' ',STR(?lat2),')')AS?str).BIND(STRDT(?str,geo:wktLiteral)AS?l)}}AS%l
WHERE{{INCLUDE%s}UNION{INCLUDE%l}.BIND(IF(BOUND(?l),"f0f","007f00") as ?rgb)SERVICE wikibase:label{bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en".}}#

instruction: What are the largest administrative divisions by country?
What are the items under 'costume accessory' in the Getty AAT thesaurus that don't have a clear subclass relationship?
Find vegan restaurants near me.
What is the average height of people with the first name Joe?
List items with more child statements than actual children.
List all members of parliament with mythical ancestors.
query:
SELECT distinct ?person ?personLabel ?born ?died
(group_concat(distinct ?classname;separator=", ") as ?class) (count(distinct ?mp) as ?descendant_mp_count) WHERE {
?mp p:P39 ?positionStatement .
?positionStatement ps:P39 wd:Q77685926 . # this person is a member of the current parliament
{ ?mp (wdt:P25|wdt:P22)* ?person . } # mp's mother or father, or their mother or father, and so on
filter not exists { ?person wdt:P31 wd:Q5 } . # the ancestor is not "a human"
?person wdt:P31 ?type . ?type rdfs:label ?classname . filter(lang(?classname) = "en") .
OPTIONAL { ?person wdt:P569 ?born } .
OPTIONAL { ?person wdt:P570 ?died } .
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
} group by ?person ?personLabel ?born ?died order by ?personLabel
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT distinct ?person ?personLabel ?born ?died
(group_concat(distinct ?classname;separator=", ") as ?class) (count(distinct ?mp) as ?descendant_mp_count) WHERE {
?mp p:[property:position held] ?positionStatement .
?positionStatement ps:[property:position held] wd:[entity:member of the 58th Parliament of the United Kingdom] . # this person is a member of the current parliament
{ ?mp (wdt:[property:mother]|wdt:[property:father])* ?person . } # mp's mother or father, or their mother or father, and so on
filter not exists { ?person wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human] } . # the ancestor is not "a human"
?person wdt:[property:instance of] ?type . ?type rdfs:label ?classname . filter(lang(?classname) = "en") .
OPTIONAL { ?person wdt:[property:date of birth] ?born } .
OPTIONAL { ?person wdt:[property:date of death] ?died } .
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
} group by ?person ?personLabel ?born ?died order by ?personLabel

instruction: How many people born in Czechia died in Germany and vice versa, grouped by decade of birth?
List all municipalities in Landkreis Leipzig with their distances to each other.
List all cities in the United States with a population between 100,000 and 600,000.
query:
SELECT DISTINCT ?city ?cityLabel ?county ?countyLabel ?state ?stateLabel ?pop ?coord
WHERE
{
?city wdt:P31 wd:Q1093829 .
?city wdt:P1082 ?pop .
FILTER (?pop >= 100000 && ?pop <= 600000)
?city wdt:P131 ?county .
?county wdt:P31/wdt:P279 wd:Q47168 .
?county wdt:P131 ?state .
?state wdt:P31 wd:Q35657 .
?city wdt:P625 ?coord .
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
} ORDER BY ?stateLabel ?countyLabel ?cityLabel
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?city ?cityLabel ?county ?countyLabel ?state ?stateLabel ?pop ?coord
WHERE
{
?city wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:city in the United States] .
?city wdt:[property:population] ?pop .
FILTER (?pop >= 100000 && ?pop <= 600000)
?city wdt:[property:located in the administrative territorial entity] ?county .
?county wdt:[property:instance of]/wdt:[property:subclass of] wd:[entity:county of the United States] .
?county wdt:[property:located in the administrative territorial entity] ?state .
?state wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:U.S. state] .
?city wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?coord .
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
} ORDER BY ?stateLabel ?countyLabel ?cityLabel

instruction: List research grants funded by AHRC, sorted by start year.
What are the shortest streets in Moscow?
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX hint: <http://www.bigdata.com/queryHints#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX psn: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value-normalized/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?length_in_meters WHERE {
hint:Query hint:optimizer 'None' .
?item wdt:[property:located in the administrative territorial entity]* wd:[entity:Moscow] .
?item (wdt:[property:instance of]/wdt:[property:subclass of]*) wd:[entity:street] .
?item p:[property:length]/psn:[property:length]/wikibase:quantityAmount ?length_in_meters .
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "ru,en". }
}
ORDER BY ?length_in_meters
LIMIT 100

instruction: List people born in Split or Šibenik who spoke or wrote Latin.
List all species depicted in Ferdinand Bauer's works, along with the number of times each appears.
annotated:
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT ?name ?taxon (COUNT(?item) as ?count) WHERE {
?item wdt:[property:creator] wd:[entity:Ferdinand Bauer]. # work by Bauer
?item wdt:[property:depicts] ?taxon. # depicting a species
?taxon wdt:[property:taxon name] ?name # taxon name of species
} GROUP BY ?name ?taxon
ORDER by DESC(?count) ?name

instruction: What items in the Ashmolean Museum are made of silk?
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?inventory (GROUP_CONCAT(?typeLabel; separator=", ") AS ?types) (YEAR(?earliest) AS ?from) (YEAR(?latest) AS ?to) WHERE {
?item p:[property:collection] [ps:[property:collection] wd:[entity:Ashmolean Museum]; pq:[property:inventory number] ?inventory].
?item wdt:[property:made from material] wd:[entity:silk]; wdt:[property:instance of] ?type;
wdt:[property:described at URL] ?url FILTER (STRSTARTS(STR(?url),"http://jameelcentre") ).
OPTIONAL {?item p:[property:inception] [pq:[property:earliest date] ?earliest; pq:[property:latest date] ?latest] }
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en".
?item rdfs:label ?itemLabel. ?type rdfs:label ?typeLabel}
} GROUP BY ?item ?itemLabel ?inventory ?earliest ?latest
ORDER BY ?from ?to ?itemLabel

instruction: List the top songs from Triple J Hottest 100 in 2019 along with their music videos.
query:
SELECT ?ranking ?song ?songLabel (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?performerLabel;separator=", ") AS ?performers) (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?ytVideoLink;separator=", ") AS ?musicVideos) WHERE {
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
?song p:P2291 ?chartedIn.
?chartedIn ps:P2291 wd:Q83572751.
?chartedIn pq:P1352 ?ranking.
?song wdt:P175 ?performer.
?performer rdfs:label ?performerLabel FILTER(lang(?performerLabel)='en').
?song wdt:P1651 ?ytVideo.
BIND(CONCAT("https://youtube.com/watch/", ?ytVideo) AS ?ytVideoLink).
}
GROUP BY ?song ?songLabel ?ranking
ORDER BY ?ranking
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?ranking ?song ?songLabel (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?performerLabel;separator=", ") AS ?performers) (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?ytVideoLink;separator=", ") AS ?musicVideos) WHERE {
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
?song p:[property:charted in] ?chartedIn.
?chartedIn ps:[property:charted in] wd:[entity:Triple J Hottest 100, 2019].
?chartedIn pq:[property:ranking] ?ranking.
?song wdt:[property:performer] ?performer.
?performer rdfs:label ?performerLabel FILTER(lang(?performerLabel)='en').
?song wdt:[property:YouTube video ID] ?ytVideo.
BIND(CONCAT("https://youtube.com/watch/", ?ytVideo) AS ?ytVideoLink).
}
GROUP BY ?song ?songLabel ?ranking
ORDER BY ?ranking

instruction: List all battles with their locations and dates.
What are the largest collections by size?
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?collection ?collectionLabel ?partofLabel ?countryLabel ?size ?partLabel WHERE {
?collection p:[property:collection or exhibition size] ?s.
?s ps:[property:collection or exhibition size] ?size
OPTIONAL {?s pq:[property:applies to part] ?part}
OPTIONAL {?collection wdt:[property:part of] ?partof . # Get the organisation the collection is part of
MINUS{ ?partof wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:Wikimedia list article] } } # but not Wikimedia list articles
OPTIONAL {?collection wdt:[property:country] ?country}
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en" }
FILTER (?size > 100)
} ORDER BY DESC(?size)

instruction: Show me the German federal election results by district in 2017 with geoshapes and color-coded votes percentage.
Show me the birthplaces of UK MPs and their constituencies on a map with different colors for each party.
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?mp ?mpLabel ?image ?pob ?pobLabel ?pobCoords ?con ?conLabel ?conCoords ?line ?rgb ?layer WHERE {
$mp wdt:[property:place of birth] ?pob .
OPTIONAL { ?mp wdt:[property:image] ?image .}
?pob wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?pobCoords .
?pob p:[property:coordinate location] [ ps:[property:coordinate location] []; psv:[property:coordinate location] [ wikibase:geoLongitude ?poblon; wikibase:geoLatitude ?poblat; ] ].
$mp p:[property:position held] ?mpstmt .
?mpstmt ps:[property:position held] wd:[entity:member of the 57th Parliament of the United Kingdom] .
?mpstmt pq:[property:electoral district] ?con .
?con wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?conCoords .
?con p:[property:coordinate location] [
ps:[property:coordinate location] [];
psv:[property:coordinate location] [
wikibase:geoLongitude ?conlon;
wikibase:geoLatitude ?conlat;
]
].
MINUS {?mpstmt pq:[property:end time] ?e }
?mpstmt pq:[property:parliamentary group] ?party .
?party wdt:[property:sRGB color hex triplet] ?rgb .
?party rdfs:label ?layer .
FILTER (LANG(?layer) = "en")
BIND(CONCAT('LINESTRING (', STR(?poblon), ' ', STR(?poblat), ',', STR(?conlon), ' ', STR(?conlat), ')') AS ?str) .
BIND(STRDT(?str, geo:wktLiteral) AS ?line)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}

instruction: List all UN member states with their head of government data completeness.
query:
SELECT DISTINCT ?country ?countryLabel ?daysInUN (SUM(?daysInOffice) AS ?daysKnown) ((100* ?daysKnown / ?daysInUN) AS ?filledPercent) WHERE {
# Current UN Member States
?country wdt:P31 wd:Q3624078 ; p:P463 ?ms .
?ms ps:P463 wd:Q1065 ; pq:P580 ?joined .
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?ms pq:P582 [] }
BIND(FLOOR(NOW()-?joined) AS ?daysInUN)
# what office(s) = head of government, and when?
?country p:P1313 ?os .
?os ps:P1313 ?office .
OPTIONAL { ?os pq:P580 ?officeStart }
OPTIONAL { ?os pq:P582 ?officeEnd }
FILTER ( !BOUND(?officeEnd) || (?officeEnd > ?joined) )
# Who has held office in that period?
BIND(IF(BOUND(?officeStart), IF(?officeStart < ?joined, ?joined, ?officeStart), ?joined) AS ?effectiveStart)
BIND(IF(BOUND(?officeEnd), ?officeEnd, NOW()) AS ?effectiveEnd)
?person wdt:P31 wd:Q5 ; p:P39 ?ps .
?ps ps:P39 ?office ; pq:P580 ?heldStart .
OPTIONAL { ?ps pq:P582 ?heldEnd }
FILTER ( !BOUND(?heldEnd) || (?heldEnd > ?effectiveStart) )
BIND(IF(BOUND(?heldEnd), ?heldEnd, NOW()) AS ?heldPeriodEnd)
BIND(IF(?heldStart < ?effectiveStart, ?effectiveStart, ?heldStart) AS ?heldPeriodStart)
BIND(FLOOR(?heldPeriodEnd - ?heldPeriodStart) AS ?daysInOffice)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}
GROUP BY ?country ?countryLabel ?daysInUN
ORDER BY DESC(?filledPercent) ?countryLabel
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?country ?countryLabel ?daysInUN (SUM(?daysInOffice) AS ?daysKnown) ((100* ?daysKnown / ?daysInUN) AS ?filledPercent) WHERE {
# Current UN Member States
?country wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:sovereign state] ; p:[property:member of] ?ms .
?ms ps:[property:member of] wd:[entity:United Nations] ; pq:[property:start time] ?joined .
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?ms pq:[property:end time] [] }
BIND(FLOOR(NOW()-?joined) AS ?daysInUN)
# what office(s) = head of government, and when?
?country p:[property:office held by head of government] ?os .
?os ps:[property:office held by head of government] ?office .
OPTIONAL { ?os pq:[property:start time] ?officeStart }
OPTIONAL { ?os pq:[property:end time] ?officeEnd }
FILTER ( !BOUND(?officeEnd) || (?officeEnd > ?joined) )
# Who has held office in that period?
BIND(IF(BOUND(?officeStart), IF(?officeStart < ?joined, ?joined, ?officeStart), ?joined) AS ?effectiveStart)
BIND(IF(BOUND(?officeEnd), ?officeEnd, NOW()) AS ?effectiveEnd)
?person wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human] ; p:[property:position held] ?ps .
?ps ps:[property:position held] ?office ; pq:[property:start time] ?heldStart .
OPTIONAL { ?ps pq:[property:end time] ?heldEnd }
FILTER ( !BOUND(?heldEnd) || (?heldEnd > ?effectiveStart) )
BIND(IF(BOUND(?heldEnd), ?heldEnd, NOW()) AS ?heldPeriodEnd)
BIND(IF(?heldStart < ?effectiveStart, ?effectiveStart, ?heldStart) AS ?heldPeriodStart)
BIND(FLOOR(?heldPeriodEnd - ?heldPeriodStart) AS ?daysInOffice)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}
GROUP BY ?country ?countryLabel ?daysInUN
ORDER BY DESC(?filledPercent) ?countryLabel

instruction: Find occupations with different female and male forms in English.
annotated:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?femaleform ?maleform ?lang WHERE {
wd:[entity:occupation] ^wdt:[property:subclass of]*/^wdt:[property:instance of] ?item.
?item wdt:[property:female form of label] ?femaleform;
wdt:[property:male form of label] ?maleform;
rdfs:label ?itemLabel.
BIND(LANG(?itemLabel) AS ?lang)
FILTER((LANG(?itemLabel)) = "en")
FILTER((LANG(?femaleform)) = ?lang)
FILTER((LANG(?maleform)) = ?lang)
FILTER(?itemLabel = ?maleform)
FILTER(?itemLabel != ?femaleform)
}
LIMIT 100

instruction: List all places in Canada without an English name.
annotated:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?label) AS ?label) (SAMPLE(?coords) AS ?coords) (GROUP_CONCAT(?lang) AS ?langs) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?label) as ?desccount)
WHERE {
?item wdt:[property:country] wd:[entity:Canada] .
?item wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?coords.
FILTER NOT EXISTS {
?item rdfs:label ?englishLabel .
FILTER(LANGMATCHES(LANG(?englishLabel),"EN"))
} .
?item rdfs:label ?label
BIND (LANG(?label) AS ?lang)
} GROUP BY ?item
ORDER BY DESC(?desccount)

instruction: Find the coordinates of manuscript collections on a map.
List all hypertext systems along with their creators and development timelines.
List all female mathematicians born or died on this day.
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?person ?personLabel ?dob ?dod WHERE {
BIND(NOW() as $today)
BIND(YEAR($today) AS $today_year)
BIND(MONTH($today) AS $today_month)
BIND(DAY($today) AS $today_day)
?person wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human].
?person wdt:[property:sex or gender] wd:[entity:female] .
OPTIONAL { ?person wdt:[property:date of birth] ?dob }
OPTIONAL { ?person wdt:[property:date of death] ?dod }
?person wdt:[property:occupation] wd:[entity:mathematician] .
FILTER( $today_month = MONTH(?dob) && $today_day = DAY(?dob) || $today_month = MONTH(?dod) && $today_day = DAY(?dod) )
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}

instruction: List all former UK MPs who are still alive, along with their first election details.

PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?article ?itemLabel ?constituencyLabel ?firstpartyLabel ?electionLabel (?start as ?firstdate) ?firsttermLabel
{
?membership wdt:[property:subclass of] wd:[entity:Member of Parliament] . # find all MP positions
?item p:[property:position held] ?positionStatement . ?positionStatement ps:[property:position held] ?membership . # and people who held such a position
OPTIONAL { ?positionStatement pq:[property:electoral district] ?constituency . } # constituency if known
OPTIONAL { ?positionStatement pq:[property:parliamentary group] ?firstparty . } # party if known
?positionStatement pq:[property:start time] ?start . ?positionStatement pq:[property:end time] ?end .
?positionStatement pq:[property:elected in] ?election . ?membership wdt:[property:parliamentary term] ?firstterm
FILTER NOT EXISTS {
?membership2 wdt:[property:subclass of] wd:[entity:Member of Parliament] .
?item p:[property:position held] ?positionStatement2 .
?positionStatement2 ps:[property:position held] ?membership2 .
?positionStatement2 pq:[property:end time] ?end2 .
FILTER (?end2 <= ?start) . } # filter out any where they served earlier
FILTER NOT EXISTS {
?membership3 wdt:[property:subclass of] wd:[entity:Member of Parliament] . ?item p:[property:position held] ?positionStatement3 .
?positionStatement3 ps:[property:position held] ?membership3 . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?positionStatement3 pq:[property:end time] ?end3 . } }
#not current
filter not exists { ?item wdt:[property:date of death] ?died } .
optional { ?article schema:about ?item . ?article schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/>. }
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language 'en' }
} order by ?firstdate

instruction: List all self-portrait paintings with their IIIF manifest URLs.
query:
SELECT DISTINCT ?qLabel ?image ?placeholder (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?collectionLabel; separator="; ") AS ?where)
(URI(CONCAT('https://tools.wmflabs.org/mirador/?manifest=', STR(?iiif))) AS ?iiiflink)
WHERE {
?q wdt:P31 wd:Q3305213; # painting
wdt:P136 wd:Q192110; # genre: self-portrait
wdt:P6108 ?iiif. # IIIF manifest link on Wikidata
OPTIONAL{ ?q wdt:P18 ?img } # Image on Commons
?q p:P195 ?s. ?s ps:P195 ?collection . MINUS {?s pq:P582 []}.
MINUS {?s ps:P195 wd:Q1322278 }
# ?collection wdt:P17 wd:Q145 # collection in the UK
BIND (IF(BOUND(?img), ?img, <http://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/No%20image%20available.svg>) AS ?image)
BIND (IF(BOUND(?img), 1, 0) AS ?placeholder)
SERVICE wikibase:label {
bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en".
?q rdfs:label ?qLabel. ?collection rdfs:label ?collectionLabel
}
} GROUP BY ?q ?qLabel ?iiif ?image ?placeholder
ORDER BY DESC(?placeholder) ?where
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?qLabel ?image ?placeholder (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?collectionLabel; separator="; ") AS ?where)
(URI(CONCAT('https://tools.wmflabs.org/mirador/?manifest=', STR(?iiif))) AS ?iiiflink)
WHERE {
?q wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:painting]; # painting
wdt:[property:genre] wd:[entity:self-portrait]; # genre: self-portrait
wdt:[property:IIIF manifest URL] ?iiif. # IIIF manifest link on Wikidata
OPTIONAL{ ?q wdt:[property:image] ?img } # Image on Commons
?q p:[property:collection] ?s. ?s ps:[property:collection] ?collection . MINUS {?s pq:[property:end time] []}.
MINUS {?s ps:[property:collection] wd:[entity:Matenadaran] }
# ?collection wdt:[property:country] wd:[entity:United Kingdom] # collection in the UK
BIND (IF(BOUND(?img), ?img, <http://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/No%20image%20available.svg>) AS ?image)
BIND (IF(BOUND(?img), 1, 0) AS ?placeholder)
SERVICE wikibase:label {
bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en".
?q rdfs:label ?qLabel. ?collection rdfs:label ?collectionLabel
}
} GROUP BY ?q ?qLabel ?iiif ?image ?placeholder
ORDER BY DESC(?placeholder) ?where

instruction: List the UK MPs who lived the longest after leaving office since 1900.
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?time ?end_causeLabel ?latest_mp ?dob1 ?dod1
WITH {
SELECT ?item (MAX(?end_time) AS ?latest_mp) (MAX(?dod) AS ?dod1) (MAX(?dob) AS ?dob1) WHERE {
OPTIONAL {?item wdt:[property:date of death] ?dod} .
?item p:[property:position held] ?mp_stmt .
?mp_stmt ps:[property:position held] ?mp .
?mp wdt:[property:subclass of] wd:[entity:Member of Parliament] .
?mp_stmt pq:[property:end time] ?end_time .
FILTER(year(?end_time) > 1899) .
OPTIONAL {?item wdt:[property:date of birth] ?dob}
} GROUP BY ?item
} AS %mps
WHERE {
INCLUDE %mps .
?item p:[property:position held] ?mp_stmt .
?mp_stmt pq:[property:end time] ?latest_mp .
?mp_stmt pq:[property:end cause] ?end_cause .
BIND(COALESCE(?dod1, now()) AS ?date) .
BIND (((?date - ?latest_mp) / 365.24) AS ?time) .
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
} ORDER BY DESC(?time)
LIMIT 200

?stat ps:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q10864048.
# ?region wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q10864048.
#UNION { ?city wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q515. }
?region wdt:P1082 ?pop.
?region wdt:P150 ?regionContained.
# only in Germany
?region wdt:P17 wd:Q183.
MINUS { ?region wdt:P576 ?x. } # remove region that has been disolved

}

wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:metro station].

BIND(CONCAT('LINESTRING(', STR(?lon1), ' ', STR(?lat1), ',', STR(?lon2), ' ', STR(?lat2), ')') AS ?str) . BIND(STRDT(?str, geo:wktLiteral) AS ?line)
?subwayLine wdt:[property:sRGB color hex triplet] ?rgb .

select ?dec ((?count/?total)*100 as ?percent) ?causeLabel where
{
{ select (str(?decade) as ?dec) (count(distinct ?ps) as ?count) ?cause where {
?mp p:[property:position held] ?ps . ?ps ps:[property:position held] ?term . ?term wdt:[property:subclass of] wd:[entity:Member of Parliament] .
?ps pq:[property:end time] ?pend . filter not exists { ?mp p:[property:position held] ?ps2 . ?ps2 ps:[property:position held] ?term . ?ps2 pq:[property:start time] ?pend }
# not new term starting same day - ie left Parliament
?ps pq:[property:end cause] ?cause .
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:dissolution of parliament] } # not dissolution
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:Suspension from the UK parliament] } # not suspension
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:suspension from a political party] } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:election as Speaker of the House] } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:leaving party] } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:joining party] } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:rejoining party] } # tofix
bind(year(?pend) as ?year) . filter(?year >= 1870) . bind((floor(?year/10)*10) as ?decade) .
} group by ?cause ?decade }
{ select (str(?decade) as ?dec) (count(distinct ?ps) as ?total) where {
?mp p:[property:position held] ?ps . ?ps ps:[property:position held] ?term . ?term wdt:[property:subclass of] wd:[entity:Member of Parliament] .
?ps pq:[property:end time] ?pend . filter not exists { ?mp p:[property:position held] ?ps2 . ?ps2 ps:[property:position held] ?term . ?ps2 pq:[property:start time] ?pend }
# not new term starting same day - ie left Parliament
?ps pq:[property:end cause] ?cause .
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:dissolution of parliament] } # not dissolution
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:Suspension from the UK parliament] } # not suspension
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:suspension from a political party] } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:election as Speaker of the House] } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:leaving party] } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:joining party] } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:rejoining party] } # tofix
bind(year(?pend) as ?year) . filter(?year >= 1870) . bind((floor(?year/10)*10) as ?decade) .
} group by ?decade }

instruction: List musicians who died at the age of 27.
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?person ?personLabel ?dob ?dod (xsd:integer(?age_) as ?age)
where {
# We do a subquery here, because otherwise we'll get a timeout because of the labels
{
SELECT DISTINCT ?person ?dob ?dod ?age_
where {
?person wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human]; # Get all humans
wdt:[property:occupation]/wdt:[property:subclass of]* wd:[entity:musician]; # That have a musician or a subclass thereof as their occupation
p:[property:date of birth] ?dob_st; # death of birth
p:[property:date of death] ?dod_st. # death of death
?dob_st psv:[property:date of birth] [ wikibase:timeValue ?dob; wikibase:timePrecision ?dob_prec ];
a wikibase:BestRank.
?dod_st psv:[property:date of death] [ wikibase:timeValue ?dod; wikibase:timePrecision ?dod_prec ];
a wikibase:BestRank.
# Only accept date precisions of a day or better, so it doesn't cause problems when we calculate age
FILTER(?dob_prec >= 11 && ?dod_prec >= 11)
# Time differences in Blazegraph are counted as days and is xsd:double
# We then calculate the age by dividing this by the orbital period of Earth
# This is a shortcut, but it is accurate enough for our purposes
bind((?dod - ?dob) / 365.2564 as ?age_)
# And filter by age
filter(?age_ >= 27.0 && ?age_ < 28.0)
}
#LIMIT 1000
}
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}
ORDER BY desc(?dod) # Order by most recent

instruction: What percentage of action films pass the Bechdel test?

SELECT ?genreLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?item)/ ?item_count AS ?share) (xsd:string(?item_count) AS ?number_of_films_with_test_data)
WITH {
SELECT ?genre ?item ?bechdel_result WHERE{
VALUES ?genre {wd:[entity:action fiction]
wd:[entity:adventure fiction]
wd:[entity:comedy]
wd:[entity:crime fiction]
wd:[entity:drama fiction]
wd:[entity:fantasy]
wd:[entity:historical fiction]
wd:[entity:horror fiction]
wd:[entity:musical film]
wd:[entity:mystery fiction]
wd:[entity:romantic fiction]
wd:[entity:science fiction]
wd:[entity:thriller]
wd:[entity:war fiction]
wd:[entity:Western]}
?st ps:[property:assessment] wd:[entity:Bechdel test]; pq:[property:assessment outcome] ?bechdel_result.
?item p:[property:assessment] ?st; wdt:[property:genre]/wdt:[property:subclass of]* ?genre; wdt:[property:instance of]/wdt:[property:subclass of]* wd:[entity:film]
}
} AS %bechdel_by_genre
WITH {
SELECT ?genre (COUNT(DISTINCT ?item) AS ?item_count) WHERE{
INCLUDE %bechdel_by_genre
}
GROUP BY ?genre
} AS %item_count_by_genre
WHERE {
INCLUDE %bechdel_by_genre
INCLUDE %item_count_by_genre
FILTER(?bechdel_result IN (wd:[entity:passes]))
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}
GROUP BY ?genreLabel ?item_count

instruction: What day of the week did most prisoners die in Mauthausen concentration camp?
query:
SELECT ?weekday (count(distinct(?item)) as ?count) WHERE {
wd:Q362 wdt:P580 ?od ; wdt:P582 ?do.
?item wdt:P20 wd:Q160139 .
?item p:P570 [ps:P570 ?date ; psv:P570/wikibase:timePrecision ?precision ] filter(?precision = 11 && day(?date) != 1 && ?date > ?od && ?date < ?do ).
BIND( DAY( ?date ) AS ?q ) .
BIND( MONTH( ?date ) + IF( MONTH( ?date ) < 3, 12, 0 ) AS ?m ) .
BIND( YEAR( ?date ) - IF( MONTH( ?date ) < 3, 1, 0 ) AS ?_year ) .
BIND( ?_year - FLOOR( ?_year / 100 ) * 100 AS ?K ) . # modulo
BIND( FLOOR( YEAR( ?date ) / 100 ) AS ?J ) .
BIND( ?q + FLOOR( 13 * ( ?m + 1 ) / 5 ) + ?K + FLOOR( ?K / 4 ) + FLOOR( ?J / 4 ) - 2 * ?J AS ?_h ) .
BIND(( ?_h - FLOOR( ?_h / 7 ) * 7) as ?day) .
BIND(if(?day=0,"06 (Saturday)",if(?day=1,"07 (Sunday)",if(?day=2,"01 (Monday)",if(?day=3,"02 (Tuesday)",if(?day=4,"03 (Wednesday)",if(?day=5,"04 (Thursday)",if(?day=6,"05 (Friday)",""))))))) as ?weekday) .
} group by ?weekday order by asc(?weekday)

instruction: What is the age of each US president and vice-president when they left office?

PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?person ?personLabel (MAX(?end_or_now) as ?last_date) (MAX(?age_end_or_now) as ?age_at_date) (?when - YEAR(?last_date) as ?years_alive_since) ?dob ?dod ?when ?age
{
VALUES ?office { wd:[entity:Vice President of the United States] wd:[entity:President of the United States] }
?st ps:[property:position held] ?office .
?person wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human]; p:[property:position held] ?st .
OPTIONAL { ?st pq:[property:end time] ?e }
BIND( COALESCE(?e, NOW() ) as ?end_or_now)
?person wdt:[property:date of birth] ?dob .
OPTIONAL { ?person wdt:[property:date of death] ?dod } .
BIND( COALESCE( YEAR( ?dod) , YEAR(NOW()) ) as ?when )
BIND( ?when - YEAR(?dob) as ?age)
BIND(YEAR(?end_or_now)-YEAR(?dob) as ?age_end_or_now)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en" }
}
GROUP BY ?person ?personLabel ?dob ?dod ?age ?when
ORDER BY DESC(?age)

instruction: List all the popes in chronological order.

What is the number of disasters that occurred on a specific date?
query:
SELECT (?q AS ?Date) (SUM(?mon) AS ?Mon) (SUM(?tue) AS ?Tue) (SUM(?wed) AS ?Wed) (SUM(?thu) AS ?Thu) (SUM(?fri) AS ?Fri) (SUM(?sat) AS ?Sat) (SUM(?sun) AS ?Sun) (COUNT(?start_time) AS ?Tot) WHERE {
{
?disaster wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q3839081 ;
p:P580 ?start_time_stm . # find the date multi-day disasters started
?start_time_stm ps:P580 ?start_time .
?start_time_stm psv:P580 ?start_time_node .
?start_time_node wikibase:timePrecision ?tp . FILTER(?tp=11)
}
UNION
{
?disaster wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q3839081 ;
p:P585 ?start_time_stm . # find all those which have "point in time" (ie one-day events)
?start_time_stm ps:P585 ?start_time .
?start_time_stm psv:P585 ?start_time_node .
?start_time_node wikibase:timePrecision ?tp . FILTER(?tp=11)
}
# this beautiful bit of code finds all the relevant days of the week
# using https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Algoritmus_pro_v%C3%BDpo%C4%8Det_dne_v_t%C3%BDdnu#Zeller%C5%AFv_algoritmus
BIND( DAY( ?start_time ) AS ?q ) .
BIND( MONTH( ?start_time ) + IF( MONTH( ?start_time ) < 3, 12, 0 ) AS ?m ) .
BIND( YEAR( ?start_time ) - IF( MONTH( ?start_time ) < 3, 1, 0 ) AS ?_year ) .
BIND( ?_year - FLOOR( ?_year / 100 ) * 100 AS ?K ) . # modulo
BIND( FLOOR( YEAR( ?start_time ) / 100 ) AS ?J ) .
BIND( ?q + FLOOR( 13 * ( ?m + 1 ) / 5 ) + ?K + FLOOR( ?K / 4 ) + FLOOR( ?J / 4 ) - 2 * ?J AS ?_h ) .
BIND( ?_h - FLOOR( ?_h / 7 ) * 7 AS ?weekday) . # modulo, 0 is Saturday
BIND(IF(?weekday=2,1,0) AS ?mon)
BIND(IF(?weekday=3,1,0) AS ?tue)
BIND(IF(?weekday=4,1,0) AS ?wed)
BIND(IF(?weekday=5,1,0) AS ?thu)
BIND(IF(?weekday=6,1,0) AS ?fri)
BIND(IF(?weekday=0,1,0) AS ?sat)
BIND(IF(?weekday=1,1,0) AS ?sun)
}
GROUP BY ?q
ORDER BY ?Date

instruction: List all humans who are citizens of France and have at least 5 Wikipedia pages in languages other than French.

?item wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human].

instruction: List countries with populations similar to a given country.
query:
SELECT ?country ?countryLabel ?population
(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?countryBLabel ; separator = ", ") AS ?similarPopulation)
WHERE {
?country wdt:P31 wd:Q6256 .
?country wdt:P1082 ?population .
?countryB wdt:P31 wd:Q6256 .
?countryB wdt:P1082 ?populationB .
FILTER (?country != ?countryB && ?populationB >= ?population * 0.95 && ?populationB <= ?population * 1.05)
?country rdfs:label ?countryLabel . FILTER (LANG(?countryLabel) = "en") .
?countryB rdfs:label ?countryBLabel . FILTER (LANG(?countryBLabel) = "en") .
}
GROUP BY ?country ?countryLabel ?population
ORDER BY ?countryLabel

instruction: List artists with the most artworks in both Tate and National Portrait Gallery collections.
List all medieval battles without a specific location.
List the heads of government who returned to power after the longest time gap.
query:
SELECT DISTINCT ?person ?personLabel ?office ?officeLabel ?end1 ?start2 (FLOOR(?days/36.525)/10 AS ?gap)
WHERE {
# Offices Held by Heads of Government
?country wdt:P31 wd:Q3624078; p:P1313/ps:P1313 ?office .
# People who have held the office more than once
?person p:P39 [ ps:P39 ?office ; pq:P582 ?end1 ] .
?person p:P39 [ ps:P39 ?office ; pq:P580 ?start2 ] .
FILTER (?start2 > ?end1)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { # but must be successive periods
?person p:P39 [ ps:P39 ?office ; pq:P580 ?start3 ] .
FILTER((?start3 > ?end1) && (?start3 < ?start2))
}
# How long between end of one term and start of the next
BIND (?start2 - ?end1 AS ?days)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}
ORDER BY DESC(?days)
LIMIT 10

PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT
?topic1 ?topic1Label ?topic2 ?topic2Label
WITH {
SELECT
(COUNT(?work) AS ?count) ?topic1 ?topic2
WHERE {
# Find works that are marked with main subject of the topic.
?work wdt:[property:main subject] / ( wdt:[property:instance of]*/wdt:[property:subclass of]* | wdt:[property:part of]+ | wdt:[property:facet of]+ ) wd:[entity:SARS-CoV-2] .
# Identify co-occuring topics.
?work wdt:[property:main subject] ?topic1, ?topic2 .
# Exclude the topic it self
FILTER (wd:[entity:SARS-CoV-2] != ?topic1 && wd:[entity:SARS-CoV-2] != ?topic2 && ?topic1 != ?topic2)
}
GROUP BY ?topic1 ?topic2
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
# There a performance problems in the browser: We cannot show large graphs,
# so we put a limit on the number of links displayed.
LIMIT 400
} AS %results
WHERE {
INCLUDE %results
# Label the results
SERVICE wikibase:label {
bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,da,de,es,fr,jp,nl,no,ru,sv,zh".
}
}

PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>

PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?material ?l ?d (COUNT(DISTINCT ?q) AS ?mcount)
WHERE {
?q (wdt:[property:instance of]/wdt:[property:subclass of]*) wd:[entity:manuscript].
?q p:[property:collection] ?s. ?s ps:[property:collection] ?collection . MINUS {?s pq:[property:end time] []}.
MINUS { ?s ps:[property:collection] wd:[entity:Matenadaran] }
?q wdt:[property:made from material] ?material
SERVICE wikibase:label {
bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en".
?material rdfs:label ?l; schema:description ?d
}
}
GROUP BY ?material ?l ?d

instruction: Show me a map of Indian districts with literacy rates in 2011.
annotated:

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?d ?dLabel ?shape ?ratio ?rgb WHERE {
?d wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:district of India]; p:[property:literate population] ?litpopstmt ; p:[property:illiterate population] ?illitpopstmt ; wdt:[property:geoshape] ?shape.
?litpopstmt ps:[property:literate population] ?litpop ; pq:[property:point in time] "+2011-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime.
?illitpopstmt ps:[property:illiterate population] ?illitpop ; pq:[property:point in time] "+2011-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime.
BIND(xsd:integer(?illitpop)/xsd:integer(?litpop) AS ?ratio)
BIND(IF(?ratio < 0.2, "00008b", IF(?ratio < 0.4, "006400", IF(?ratio < 0.6, "008000", IF(?ratio < 0.8, "32cd32", IF(?ratio < 1, "7fff00", IF(?ratio < 1.2, "ffa500", IF(?ratio < 1.4, "ff6347", "ff0000"))))))) AS ?rgb)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}

instruction: List all TV series with their narrative locations.
List all railway stations in the Baltic region.
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX gas: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf/gas#>

SELECT ?station ?line (CEIL(?depth/10)*10 as ?layer) ?coord {
SERVICE gas:service {
gas:program gas:gasClass "com.bigdata.rdf.graph.analytics.BFS" ; gas:in wd:[entity:Rīga Pasažieru] ; gas:out ?station ; gas:out1 ?depth ; gas:out2 ?pred .
gas:program gas:linkType wdt:[property:adjacent station] . }
FILTER(?station != wd:[entity:Rīga Pasažieru])
?pred wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?cds.
BIND(IF(xsd:double(?depth/10) = xsd:integer(?depth/10),?cds,"") as ?coords)
?pred p:[property:coordinate location]/psv:[property:coordinate location]/wikibase:geoLatitude ?lat1 ; p:[property:coordinate location]/psv:[property:coordinate location]/wikibase:geoLongitude ?lon1 .
?station p:[property:coordinate location]/psv:[property:coordinate location]/wikibase:geoLatitude ?lat2 ; p:[property:coordinate location]/psv:[property:coordinate location]/wikibase:geoLongitude ?lon2 .
values ?country { wd:[entity:Latvia] wd:[entity:Lithuania] wd:[entity:Estonia] wd:[entity:Russia] wd:[entity:Belarus] } ?station wdt:[property:country] ?country .
# only Baltics or Russia or Belarus
BIND(CONCAT('LINESTRING(', STR(?lon1), ' ', STR(?lat1), ',', STR(?lon2), ' ', STR(?lat2), ')') AS ?str) . BIND(STRDT(?str, geo:wktLiteral) AS ?line)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "bn,en". }
?station wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?coord.
}

instruction: Find the ancestors of Boris Johnson and Jesus who are also descendants of George I and Abraham.
List all individuals with the first name Elisabeth or Elizabeth.
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>

PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?itemDescription (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE {
VALUES ?target {
wd:[entity:Elizabeth]
wd:[entity:Elisabeth]
wd:[entity:Élisabeth]
}
?item wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human];
p:[property:given name] ?statement.
?statement ps:[property:given name] ?target.
OPTIONAL { ?statement pq:[property:series ordinal] ?rank. }
BIND(IF(BOUND(?rank),?rank, 0) AS ?rank2)
FILTER(xsd:integer(?rank2) < xsd:integer(2))
?sitelink schema:about ?item.
FILTER (SUBSTR(str(?sitelink), 11, 15) = ".wikipedia.org/") .
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "fr,en". }
}
GROUP BY ?item ?itemLabel ?itemDescription
ORDER BY DESC (?count)
LIMIT 100

instruction: Show me a map of Finistere with the birthplaces of women marked.
How many lexeme pairs exist between different languages?
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT
?language1 ?language1Label ?language2 ?language2Label
?number_of_lexemes
WITH {
SELECT ?language1 ?language2 (COUNT(*) AS ?number_of_lexemes) {
[] ^wdt:[property:item for this sense] / ^ontolex:sense ?lexeme1, ?lexeme2 .
FILTER (?lexeme1 != ?lexeme2)
?lexeme1 dct:language ?language1 .
?lexeme2 dct:language ?language2 .
FILTER (?language1 != ?language2)
FILTER (STR(?language1) > STR(?language2))
}
GROUP BY ?language1 ?language2
ORDER BY DESC(?number_of_lexemes)
LIMIT 100
} AS %result
{
INCLUDE %result
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}
ORDER BY DESC(?number_of_lexemes)

instruction: What is the decrease in sex ratio for mandals of West Godavari district between 2001 and 2011?
query:
SELECT DISTINCT ?vLabel ?pop {
?v wdt:P31 wd:Q13005188 .
?v wdt:P131* wd:Q15404.
?v p:P1539 ?fps11. ?fps11 ps:P1539 ?fp11. ?fps11 pq:P585 ?fp11d. FILTER(year(?fp11d) = 2011).
?v p:P1539 ?fps01. ?fps01 ps:P1539 ?fp01. ?fps01 pq:P585 ?fp01d. FILTER(year(?fp01d) = 2001).
?v p:P1540 ?mps11. ?mps11 ps:P1540 ?mp11. ?mps11 pq:P585 ?mp11d. FILTER(year(?mp11d) = 2011).
?v p:P1540 ?mps01. ?mps01 ps:P1540 ?mp01. ?mps01 pq:P585 ?mp01d. FILTER(year(?mp01d) = 2001).
BIND((xsd:integer(?mp11)/xsd:integer(?fp11)) - (xsd:integer(?mp01)/xsd:integer(?fp01)) as ?change)
BIND(IF(?change < 0, -1 * ?change, 0) as ?pop).
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "te,en" }
}
GROUP BY ?pop ?vLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?pop)
#
annotated:

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?vLabel ?pop {
?v wdt:[property:instance of] wd:Q13005188 .
?v wdt:[property:located in the administrative territorial entity]* wd:[entity:West Godavari district].
?v p:[property:female population] ?fps11. ?fps11 ps:[property:female population] ?fp11. ?fps11 pq:[property:point in time] ?fp11d. FILTER(year(?fp11d) = 2011).
?v p:[property:female population] ?fps01. ?fps01 ps:[property:female population] ?fp01. ?fps01 pq:[property:point in time] ?fp01d. FILTER(year(?fp01d) = 2001).
?v p:[property:male population] ?mps11. ?mps11 ps:[property:male population] ?mp11. ?mps11 pq:[property:point in time] ?mp11d. FILTER(year(?mp11d) = 2011).
?v p:[property:male population] ?mps01. ?mps01 ps:[property:male population] ?mp01. ?mps01 pq:[property:point in time] ?mp01d. FILTER(year(?mp01d) = 2001).
BIND((xsd:integer(?mp11)/xsd:integer(?fp11)) - (xsd:integer(?mp01)/xsd:integer(?fp01)) as ?change)
BIND(IF(?change < 0, -1 * ?change, 0) as ?pop).
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "te,en" }
}
GROUP BY ?pop ?vLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?pop)
#

instruction: Find the nearest library to each public bookcase in Vienna.
List all lexemes with their corresponding lemmas and languages where the lemma's length matches its numeric value.
List the years since 2000 with the ratio of famous people's deaths.
query:
SELECT
(STR(?year) AS ?year_) # STR(): work around T150515
# uncomment the below three lines for a more useful Table view
#(SUM(?famous) AS ?famousCount)
#(COUNT(person) AS ?totalCount)
#(?famousCount/?totalCount AS ?ratio)
# this line compresses the above three lines into one because otherwise the Line Chart would display ?famousCount whereas we want ?ratio
(SUM(?famous)/COUNT(?person) AS ?ratio)
WHERE {
?person wdt:P31 wd:Q5;
wdt:P570 ?died;
wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks.
FILTER(?died >= "2000-01-01"^^xsd:dateTime).
BIND(YEAR(?died) AS ?year).
BIND(IF(?sitelinks >= 25, 1, 0) AS ?famous).
}
GROUP BY ?year
ORDER BY ?year

SELECT
(STR(?year) AS ?year_) # STR(): work around T150515
# uncomment the below three lines for a more useful Table view
#(SUM(?famous) AS ?famousCount)
#(COUNT(person) AS ?totalCount)
#(?famousCount/?totalCount AS ?ratio)
# this line compresses the above three lines into one because otherwise the Line Chart would display ?famousCount whereas we want ?ratio
(SUM(?famous)/COUNT(?person) AS ?ratio)

wdt:[property:date of death] ?died;
wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks.

instruction: What are the different flags used in Afghanistan?
List all the World Heritage sites that were newly protected in 2021.
