List the UK political parties that have appointed a new leader after a general election since 1945.
query:
select distinct ?item ?itemLabel ?leadership_start_time (MAX(?elec_date) AS ?elec_date) (MIN(?days) AS ?days)
with {
select ?elec ?elec_date WHERE {
?elec wdt:P31 wd:Q15283424 .
?elec wdt:P585 ?elec_date .
}
} AS %elections
where {
hint:Query hint:optimizer "None".
?role wdt:P279? wd:Q1553195 .
?pos_stmt ps:P39 ?role .
?pos_stmt pq:P580 ?leadership_start_time .
FILTER (year(?leadership_start_time) > 1945) .
MINUS {?role p:P279/pq:P642/wdt:P31 wd:Q848197} .
?item p:P39 ?pos_stmt .
?item wdt:P39/wdt:P279 wd:Q16707842 .
INCLUDE %elections .
FILTER (?elec_date < ?leadership_start_time).
BIND ((?leadership_start_time - ?elec_date) AS ?days)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". } .
} GROUP BY ?item ?itemLabel ?leadership_start_time
ORDER BY DESC(?days)

select distinct ?item ?itemLabel ?leadership_start_time (MAX(?elec_date) AS ?elec_date) (MIN(?days) AS ?days)
with {
select ?elec ?elec_date WHERE {
?elec wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:United Kingdom general election] .
?elec wdt:[property:point in time] ?elec_date .
}
} AS %elections
where {
hint:Query hint:optimizer "None".
?role wdt:[property:subclass of]? wd:[entity:party leader] .
?pos_stmt ps:[property:position held] ?role .
?pos_stmt pq:[property:start time] ?leadership_start_time .
FILTER (year(?leadership_start_time) > 1945) .
MINUS {?role p:[property:subclass of]/pq:[property:of]/wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:parliamentary group]} .
?item p:[property:position held] ?pos_stmt .
?item wdt:[property:position held]/wdt:[property:subclass of] wd:[entity:Member of Parliament] .
INCLUDE %elections .
FILTER (?elec_date < ?leadership_start_time).
BIND ((?leadership_start_time - ?elec_date) AS ?days)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". } .
} GROUP BY ?item ?itemLabel ?leadership_start_time
ORDER BY DESC(?days)

rdfs:label ?language .

instruction: List the countries of origin for winners of the European Film Award for Best European Film.
query:
SELECT ?countryLabel (STR(YEAR(?date)) AS ?year) ?title WHERE {
#getting award winners for each year
?item p:P166 ?st1; wdt:P31 wd:Q11424. ?st1 ps:P166 wd:Q777921; pq:P585 ?date.
#making sure the statement is sourced with a page from the domain "www.europeanfilmacademy.org"
?st1 prov:wasDerivedFrom ?ref1.
?ref1 pr:P854 ?url1. FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?url1), "www.europeanfilmacademy.org"))
#getting country of origin
?item p:P495 ?st2.
#making sure the country of origin is sourced with a page from the domain "www.europeanfilmawards.eu"
?st2 ps:P495 ?country; prov:wasDerivedFrom ?ref2.
?ref2 pr:P854 ?url2. FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?url2), "www.europeanfilmawards.eu"))
#getting the titles
?item wdt:P1476 ?orig_title; rdfs:label ?label. FILTER(LANG(?label)="en")
BIND(IF(LANG(?orig_title) IN ("en", "en-gb", "en-us") || STR(?orig_title)=STR(?label), ?orig_title, CONCAT(?orig_title, " (", ?label, ")")) AS ?title)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}
ORDER BY ?year ?countryLabel
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX pr: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/reference/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?countryLabel (STR(YEAR(?date)) AS ?year) ?title WHERE {
#getting award winners for each year
?item p:[property:award received] ?st1; wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:film]. ?st1 ps:[property:award received] wd:[entity:European Film Award for Best Film]; pq:[property:point in time] ?date.
#making sure the statement is sourced with a page from the domain "www.europeanfilmacademy.org"
?st1 prov:wasDerivedFrom ?ref1.
?ref1 pr:[property:reference URL] ?url1. FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?url1), "www.europeanfilmacademy.org"))
#getting country of origin
?item p:[property:country of origin] ?st2.
#making sure the country of origin is sourced with a page from the domain "www.europeanfilmawards.eu"
?st2 ps:[property:country of origin] ?country; prov:wasDerivedFrom ?ref2.
?ref2 pr:[property:reference URL] ?url2. FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?url2), "www.europeanfilmawards.eu"))
#getting the titles
?item wdt:[property:title] ?orig_title; rdfs:label ?label. FILTER(LANG(?label)="en")
BIND(IF(LANG(?orig_title) IN ("en", "en-gb", "en-us") || STR(?orig_title)=STR(?label), ?orig_title, CONCAT(?orig_title, " (", ?label, ")")) AS ?title)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}
ORDER BY ?year ?countryLabel

instruction: List the oldest UK members of parliament at the time of their election.
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?itemLabel ?start ?parl_start ?age ?dob ?dod WHERE {
VALUES ?parl {wd:[entity:Member of Parliament] wd:[entity:Member of Parliament of Great Britain] wd:[entity:Member of Parliament in the Parliament of England]}
?item p:[property:position held] ?pos_stmt .
?pos_stmt ps:[property:position held] ?pos .
?pos wdt:[property:subclass of] ?parl .
OPTIONAL {
?pos_stmt pq:[property:start time] ?start .
}
OPTIONAL {
?pos wdt:[property:inception] ?parl_start .
}
BIND(COALESCE(?start, ?parl_start) AS ?best_start) .
?item p:[property:date of birth] ?dob_stmt .
?dob_stmt ps:[property:date of birth] ?dob .
FILTER(isLiteral(?dob)) .
?dob_stmt psv:[property:date of birth]/wikibase:timePrecision ?dob_precision .
FILTER(?dob_precision > 8) .
BIND (((?best_start - ?dob)/365.24) AS ?age) .
OPTIONAL {?item wdt:[property:date of death] ?dod} .
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
} ORDER BY DESC(?age)
LIMIT 200

instruction: List all economists along with their birthplaces and coordinates.
annotated:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT ?person ?name ?coord ?place ?birthplace ?birthyear WHERE {
{?person wdt:[property:occupation] wd:[entity:economist] .} UNION {?person wd:[property:field of work] wd:[entity:economics].}. MINUS {?person wdt:[property:occupation] wd:[entity:economist]. ?person wd:[property:field of work] wd:[entity:economics].}
?person wdt:[property:place of birth] ?place .
?place wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?coord .
OPTIONAL { ?person wdt:[property:date of birth] ?dob .}.
BIND(YEAR(?dob) as ?birthyear).
?person rdfs:label ?name filter (lang(?name) = "en")
?place rdfs:label ?birthplace filter (lang(?birthplace) = "en")
}

instruction: List all lexeme senses described in the Comprehensive Grammar of Korean.
List all Law & Order episodes with their corresponding season and episode numbers.
List the mathematicians with the most eponymous concepts.
What are the most common causes of death among noble people?
How many articles about humans are categorized by gender on Welsh Wikipedia?
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?genderLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?article) AS ?count)
WHERE {
?item wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human] .
?item wdt:[property:sex or gender] ?gender .
?article schema:about ?item .
?article schema:isPartOf <https://cy.wikipedia.org/>
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" . }
} GROUP BY ?genderLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?linkcount)

instruction: List all countries that existed in 1754.
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?h ?hLabel ?inception ?dissolved ?coor
WHERE
{
  VALUES ?countryclass { wd:[entity:historical country] wd:[entity:country] wd:[entity:sovereign state] }
  ?h p:[property:instance of]/ps:[property:instance of] ?countryclass .
  ?h wdt:[property:inception] ?inception .
  OPTIONAL { ?h wdt:[property:dissolved, abolished or demolished date] ?dissolved } .
  FILTER (?inception < "1755-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime)
  FILTER (?dissolved >= "1755-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime || !Bound(?dissolved) )
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en" }
  OPTIONAL { ?h wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?coor } .
}
ORDER BY ?inception

instruction: List all items with unknown or no values for their properties.
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?item ?prefix ?valueorstatementnode ?typeOfStatementNode ?customText
WHERE
{
#for selected items
VALUES ?item {
wd:[entity:Adolf Lorenz]
wd:[entity:anonymous]
}
?item ?prefix ?valueorstatementnode.
BIND(xsd:integer(IF(fn:starts-with(STR(?prefix), "http://www.wikidata.org/prop/P"), fn:replace(STR(?prefix), "http://www.wikidata.org/prop/P", ""), "???")) as ?pid)
BIND(IRI(CONCAT("http://www.wikidata.org/prop/novalue/P", STR(?pid))) as ?possibleWDNO)
OPTIONAL
{
?valueorstatementnode rdf:type ?typeOfStatementNode. # information about "no value" stored as type
}
BIND(IF(isBlank(?valueorstatementnode), "unknown value", IF(?typeOfStatementNode = ?possibleWDNO, "no value", ?value)) as ?customText)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" }
}
ORDER BY DESC(?customText)

instruction: What grammatical features are used in French words?
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?grammaticalFeature ?grammaticalFeatureLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?lexeme) AS ?count) (SAMPLE(?lexeme) AS ?sample) {
?lexeme dct:language wd:[entity:French] ; ontolex:lexicalForm/wikibase:grammaticalFeature ?grammaticalFeature .
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en" }
}
GROUP BY ?grammaticalFeature ?grammaticalFeatureLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count) ?grammaticalFeatureLabel

annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX gas: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf/gas#>

SELECT ?line (CEIL(?depth/10)*10 as ?layer) {
SERVICE gas:service {
gas:program gas:gasClass "com.bigdata.rdf.graph.analytics.BFS" ; gas:in wd:[entity:St Pancras railway station] ; gas:out ?station ; gas:out1 ?depth ; gas:out2 ?pred .
gas:program gas:linkType wdt:[property:adjacent station] . }
FILTER(?station != wd:[entity:St Pancras railway station])
?pred wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?cds.
BIND(IF(xsd:double(?depth/10) = xsd:integer(?depth/10),?cds,"") as ?coords)
?pred p:[property:coordinate location]/psv:[property:coordinate location]/wikibase:geoLatitude ?lat1 ; p:[property:coordinate location]/psv:[property:coordinate location]/wikibase:geoLongitude ?lon1 .
?station p:[property:coordinate location]/psv:[property:coordinate location]/wikibase:geoLatitude ?lat2 ; p:[property:coordinate location]/psv:[property:coordinate location]/wikibase:geoLongitude ?lon2 .
BIND(CONCAT('LINESTRING(', STR(?lon1), ' ', STR(?lat1), ',', STR(?lon2), ' ', STR(?lat2), ')') AS ?str) . BIND(STRDT(?str, geo:wktLiteral) AS ?line)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "bn,en". }
}

instruction: What are the historical Chinese states in the Imperial period?
What are the countries with the largest elevation spans?
List the last meals of famous people.
List all free software licenses used in describing software.
List the percentage of female Nobel Prize winners by decade.
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?decade (SUM(?female) AS ?count_females) (SUM(?male) AS ?count_males) (COUNT(*) AS ?count) ((100 * ?count_females) / ?count AS ?share_female) WHERE {
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
?award wdt:[property:subclass of] wd:[entity:Nobel Prize].
?item p:[property:award received] _:b1;
wdt:[property:sex or gender] ?gender.
_:b1 ps:[property:award received] ?award;
pq:[property:point in time] ?date.
BIND(CONCAT(STR(ROUND((YEAR(?date)) / 10 )), "0") AS ?decade)
BIND(IF(?gender IN(wd:[entity:male], wd:[entity:trans man]), 1 , 0 ) AS ?male)
BIND(IF(?gender IN(wd:[entity:female], wd:[entity:trans woman]), 1 , 0 ) AS ?female)
}
GROUP BY ?decade
ORDER BY DESC (?decade)

instruction: List the reasons why UK MPs left Parliament, grouped by decade since the 1890s.
query:
select (str(?decade) as ?dec) (count(distinct ?ps) as ?count) ?causeLabel where
{
?mp p:P39 ?ps . ?ps ps:P39 ?term . ?term wdt:P279 wd:Q16707842 .
?ps pq:P582 ?pend . filter not exists { ?mp p:P39 ?ps2 . ?ps2 ps:P39 ?term . ?ps2 pq:P580 ?pend }
# not new term starting same day - ie left Parliament
?ps pq:P1534 ?cause .
filter not exists { ?ps pq:P1534 wd:Q741182 } # not dissolution
filter not exists { ?ps pq:P1534 wd:Q7649223 } # not suspension
filter not exists { ?ps pq:P1534 wd:Q35855188 } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:P1534 wd:Q36345696 } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:P1534 wd:Q30580660 } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:P1534 wd:Q52084147 } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:P1534 wd:Q35867887 } # tofix
bind(year(?pend) as ?year) . filter(?year >= 1880) . bind((floor(?year/10)*10) as ?decade) .
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
} group by ?causeLabel ?decade order by ?causeLabel
#defaultView:BarChart
annotated:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

select (str(?decade) as ?dec) (count(distinct ?ps) as ?count) ?causeLabel where
{
?mp p:[property:position held] ?ps . ?ps ps:[property:position held] ?term . ?term wdt:[property:subclass of] wd:[entity:Member of Parliament] .
?ps pq:[property:end time] ?pend . filter not exists { ?mp p:[property:position held] ?ps2 . ?ps2 ps:[property:position held] ?term . ?ps2 pq:[property:start time] ?pend }
# not new term starting same day - ie left Parliament
?ps pq:[property:end cause] ?cause .
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:dissolution of parliament] } # not dissolution
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:Suspension from the UK parliament] } # not suspension
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:suspension from a political party] } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:election as Speaker of the House] } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:leaving party] } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:joining party] } # tofix
filter not exists { ?ps pq:[property:end cause] wd:[entity:rejoining party] } # tofix
bind(year(?pend) as ?year) . filter(?year >= 1880) . bind((floor(?year/10)*10) as ?decade) .
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
} group by ?causeLabel ?decade order by ?causeLabel
#defaultView:BarChart

instruction: Find the birthplaces of people with names like Antoine, Tony, or Antonio.
Find the list of mountains in Austria along with their heights and coordinates.
query:
SELECT ?x ?xLabel ?description ?x_coords ?rgb WITH {
# extract the data
SELECT ?data ?x ?x_coords WHERE {
?x wdt:P31 wd:Q8502 .
?x p:P2044/psn:P2044 [
wikibase:quantityAmount ?data
] .
?x wdt:P17 wd:Q40 .
?x wdt:P625 ?x_coords .
}
} AS %totals
# determine the max and min values (used to calculate the spread
WITH {
SELECT (MAX(?data) AS ?max_data) (MIN(?data) AS ?min_data) WHERE {
INCLUDE %totals
}} AS %min_max
WHERE {
INCLUDE %totals
INCLUDE %min_max
?x rdfs:label ?xLabel. FILTER (LANG(?xLabel) = "en") .
BIND (CONCAT("The height of ", ?xLabel, " is about ", STR(ROUND(?data)), " metres" ) AS ?description)
BIND ( ?max_data - ?min_data AS ?spread )
BIND ( xsd:integer( 100 * (?data - ?min_data) / ?spread) AS ?percent ) # 0 -> 100
# some example hues 0:red, 20:orange, 50:yellow, 90:green, 180:cyan, 220:blue, 280:indigo, 330:violet, 340:red
# varying hue
# BIND ( 255 * ?percent / 100 + 0 AS ?hue )
# BIND (1 AS ?value) #
# BIND (1 AS ?saturation) . # 0 -> 1
# varying the hue's value
BIND ( (1 - ?percent / 100 + 0) AS ?value ) # to black
BIND ( 255 * ?percent / 100 + 0 AS ?hue )
BIND (1 AS ?saturation) . # 0 -> 1
# varying the hue's saturation
# BIND ( (1 - ?percent / 100 + 0) AS ?saturation ) # to -> white
# BIND (0 AS ?hue) # red
# BIND (1 AS ?value) . # 0 -> 1
# the following algorithm based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/3018313/algorithm-to-convert-rgb-to-hsv-and-hsv-to-rgb-in-range-0-255-for-both
BIND ( ?hue / 60 AS ?hh )
BIND ( FLOOR (?hh) AS ?i ) .
BIND ( ?hh - ?i AS ?ff) .
BIND ( ?value * ( 1 - ?saturation ) AS ?p) .
BIND ( ?value * ( 1 - ( ?saturation * ?ff)) AS ?q ) .
BIND ( ?value * ( 1 - ( ?saturation * (1 - ?ff ))) AS ?t ) .
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?i = 0, ?value, 1/0),
IF(?i = 1, ?q, 1/0),
IF(?i = 2, ?p, 1/0),
IF(?i = 3, ?p, 1/0),
IF(?i = 4, ?t, 1/0),
IF(?i = 5, ?value, 1/0),
?value
) AS ?r )
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?i = 0, ?t, 1/0),
IF(?i = 1, ?value, 1/0),
IF(?i = 2, ?value, 1/0),
IF(?i = 3, ?q, 1/0),
IF(?i = 4, ?p, 1/0),
IF(?i = 5, ?p, 1/0),
?p
) AS ?g )
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?i = 0, ?p, 1/0),
IF(?i = 1, ?p, 1/0),
IF(?i = 2, ?t, 1/0),
IF(?i = 3, ?value, 1/0),
IF(?i = 4, ?value, 1/0),
IF(?i = 5, ?q, 1/0),
?q
) AS ?b )
BIND (FLOOR(255 * ?r) AS ?red)
BIND (FLOOR(255 * ?g) AS ?green)
BIND (FLOOR(255 * ?b) AS ?blue)
# red
BIND ( FLOOR (?red / 16) AS ?red_1 )
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?red_1 < 10, STR(?red_1), 1/0),
IF(?red_1 = 10, "a", 1/0),
IF(?red_1 = 11, "b", 1/0),
IF(?red_1 = 12, "c", 1/0),
IF(?red_1 = 13, "d", 1/0),
IF(?red_1 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?red_1 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?red_hex1 )
BIND (FLOOR(?red - (16 * xsd:integer( ?red / 16 ))) AS ?red_2)
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?red_2 < 10, STR(?red_2), 1/0),
IF(?red_2 = 10, "a", 1/0),
IF(?red_2 = 11, "b", 1/0),
IF(?red_2 = 12, "c", 1/0),
IF(?red_2 = 13, "d", 1/0),
IF(?red_2 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?red_2 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?red_hex2 )
BIND (CONCAT(STR(?red_hex1), STR(?red_hex2)) AS ?red_hex )
# green
BIND ( FLOOR (?green / 16) AS ?green_1 )
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?green_1 < 10, STR(?green_1), 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 10, "a", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 11, "b", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 12, "c", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 13, "d", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?green_hex1 )
BIND (FLOOR(?green - (16 * xsd:integer( ?green / 16 ))) AS ?green_2)
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?green_2 < 10, STR(?green_2), 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 10, "a", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 11, "b", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 12, "c", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 13, "d", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?green_hex2 )
BIND (CONCAT(STR(?green_hex1), STR(?green_hex2)) AS ?green_hex )
# blue
BIND ( FLOOR (?blue / 16) AS ?blue_1 )
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?blue_1 < 10, STR(?blue_1), 1/0),
IF(?blue_1 = 10, "a", 1/0),
IF(?blue_1 = 11, "b", 1/0),
IF(?blue_1 = 12, "c", 1/0),
IF(?blue_1 = 13, "d", 1/0),
IF(?blue_1 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?blue_1 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?blue_hex1 )
BIND (FLOOR(?blue - (16 * xsd:integer( ?blue / 16 ))) AS ?blue_2)
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?blue_2 < 10, STR(?blue_2), 1/0),
IF(?blue_2 = 10, "a", 1/0),
IF(?blue_2 = 11, "b", 1/0),
IF(?blue_2 = 12, "c", 1/0),
IF(?blue_2 = 13, "d", 1/0),
IF(?blue_2 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?blue_2 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?blue_hex2 )
BIND (CONCAT(STR(?blue_hex1), STR(?blue_hex2)) AS ?blue_hex )
BIND (CONCAT(STR(?red_hex), STR(?green_hex), STR(?blue_hex)) AS ?rgb)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}
annotated:

IF(?red_2 = 12, "c", 1/0),

IF(?red_2 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?red_2 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?red_hex2 )
BIND (CONCAT(STR(?red_hex1), STR(?red_hex2)) AS ?red_hex )
# green
BIND ( FLOOR (?green / 16) AS ?green_1 )
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?green_1 < 10, STR(?green_1), 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 10, "a", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 11, "b", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 12, "c", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 13, "d", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?green_1 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?green_hex1 )
BIND (FLOOR(?green - (16 * xsd:integer( ?green / 16 ))) AS ?green_2)
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?green_2 < 10, STR(?green_2), 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 10, "a", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 11, "b", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 12, "c", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 13, "d", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?green_2 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?green_hex2 )
BIND (CONCAT(STR(?green_hex1), STR(?green_hex2)) AS ?green_hex )
# blue
BIND ( FLOOR (?blue / 16) AS ?blue_1 )
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?blue_1 < 10, STR(?blue_1), 1/0),
IF(?blue_1 = 10, "a", 1/0),
IF(?blue_1 = 11, "b", 1/0),
IF(?blue_1 = 12, "c", 1/0),
IF(?blue_1 = 13, "d", 1/0),
IF(?blue_1 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?blue_1 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?blue_hex1 )
BIND (FLOOR(?blue - (16 * xsd:integer( ?blue / 16 ))) AS ?blue_2)
BIND ( COALESCE(
IF(?blue_2 < 10, STR(?blue_2), 1/0),
IF(?blue_2 = 10, "a", 1/0),
IF(?blue_2 = 11, "b", 1/0),
IF(?blue_2 = 12, "c", 1/0),
IF(?blue_2 = 13, "d", 1/0),
IF(?blue_2 = 14, "e", 1/0),
IF(?blue_2 = 15, "f", 1/0),
"ERROR"
) AS ?blue_hex2 )
BIND (CONCAT(STR(?blue_hex1), STR(?blue_hex2)) AS ?blue_hex )
BIND (CONCAT(STR(?red_hex), STR(?green_hex), STR(?blue_hex)) AS ?rgb)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}

instruction: Show me a map of ancient structures in Portugal and Spain.
List all biomarkers that interact with proteins in human pathways from Wikipathways.
query:
SELECT DISTINCT ?biomarkerLabel ?proteinLabel ?geneID ?WP_gene ?PathwayID ?PathwayName #results that are displayed.
WHERE {
VALUES ?biomarker {wd:Q420633 wd:Q27125809 wd:Q422462} #you can add more biomarkers here if needed, separated by a space.
?biomarker wdt:P31 wd:Q11173. #Stating that all biomarkers have to be "instance of" "chemical compound" (you could ommit this, but query will probably take longer).
?biomarker wdt:P638 ?pdbID . #Checking if a biomarker has a Protein Databank ID (PDB) -> meaning the metabolite can interact with a protein.
?protein wdt:P31 wd:Q8054 . #Stating that all proteins are "instance of" "protein"
?protein wdt:P638 ?pdbID . #Checking which proteins have a PDB ID, which we queried previously in relationship to the biomarkers.
?protein wdt:P702 ?gene . #Connecting the protein to a gene ("encoded by" relationship) -> to get an identifier we can use later in federated WikiPathways query.
?gene wdt:P703 wd:Q15978631 . #Now removing all genes that are not found in species "Homo sapiens". -> This info is not always available for proteins in WikiData.
?gene wdt:P2888 ?geneID . #Getting the "exact match" identifier for the gene, related to the protein, related to the biomarker.
##The IRI from Wikidata starts with http:// , where the one from WikiPathways starts with https:// , so we need to rewrite the IRI
BIND( # Bind the created IRI into a new variable (called ?newIRI)
IRI( # Convert the string back to an IRI
CONCAT( # Concatenate item 1 and 2 together as one string
"https", # First item to concat (more items can be added with a comma
#Second item to concat:
SUBSTR( # Obtain a substring
STR(?geneID), # Convert the geneID IRI from Wikidata to a string,
5) # removing the first 5 characters (<http)
)) AS ?newIRI # Name for the new variable
)
SERVICE <http://sparql.wikipathways.org/sparql> { #Connecting to the WikiPathways SPARQL endpoint.
?WP_pathway a wp:Pathway . #Stating a ?WP_pathway is indeed a pathway in the WikiPathways RDF .
?WP_pathway wp:organismName "Homo sapiens" . #Removing all PWs not for species Homo sapiens.
?WP_pathway dc:identifier ?PathwayID . #Query the identifier of the pathway in WPs.
?WP_pathway dc:title ?PathwayName . #Obtaining the name of the pathway.
?WP_gene a wp:Protein . #Stating that a ?WP_gene is a Protein DataNode (you could ommit this, to also get all DataNodes modeled as GeneProducts out, but query will take longer).
?WP_gene wp:bdbEntrezGene ?newIRI . #Connecting the previously queried "exact match" from WikiData to the NCBI/Entrez Gene ID in WPs.
?WP_gene dcterms:isPartOf ?WP_pathway . #Connecting the WP_gene to the WP_pathway.
}
OPTIONAL {?biomarker rdfs:label ?biomarkerLabel. #Create a label (aka name) for the biomarkers in WikiData, without using the service query.
FILTER(LANG(?biomarkerLabel) = "en").
}
OPTIONAL {?protein rdfs:label ?proteinLabel. #Create a label(aka name) for the proteins in WikiData, without using the service query.
FILTER(LANG(?proteinLabel) = "en").
}
}
ORDER BY DESC (?biomarkerLabel) #Order results for biomarkers
annotated:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wp: <http://vocabularies.wikipathways.org/wp#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?biomarkerLabel ?proteinLabel ?geneID ?WP_gene ?PathwayID ?PathwayName #results that are displayed.
WHERE {
VALUES ?biomarker {wd:[entity:phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate] wd:[entity:5-formamido-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxamide(2-)] wd:[entity:guanosine]} #you can add more biomarkers here if needed, separated by a space.
?biomarker wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:chemical compound]. #Stating that all biomarkers have to be "instance of" "chemical compound" (you could ommit this, but query will probably take longer).
?biomarker wdt:[property:PDB structure ID] ?pdbID . #Checking if a biomarker has a Protein Databank ID (PDB) -> meaning the metabolite can interact with a protein.
?protein wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:protein] . #Stating that all proteins are "instance of" "protein"
?protein wdt:[property:PDB structure ID] ?pdbID . #Checking which proteins have a PDB ID, which we queried previously in relationship to the biomarkers.
?protein wdt:[property:encoded by] ?gene . #Connecting the protein to a gene ("encoded by" relationship) -> to get an identifier we can use later in federated WikiPathways query.
?gene wdt:[property:found in taxon] wd:[entity:Homo sapiens] . #Now removing all genes that are not found in species "Homo sapiens". -> This info is not always available for proteins in WikiData.
?gene wdt:[property:exact match] ?geneID . #Getting the "exact match" identifier for the gene, related to the protein, related to the biomarker.
##The IRI from Wikidata starts with http:// , where the one from WikiPathways starts with https:// , so we need to rewrite the IRI
BIND( # Bind the created IRI into a new variable (called ?newIRI)
IRI( # Convert the string back to an IRI
CONCAT( # Concatenate item 1 and 2 together as one string
"https", # First item to concat (more items can be added with a comma
#Second item to concat:
SUBSTR( # Obtain a substring
STR(?geneID), # Convert the geneID IRI from Wikidata to a string,
5) # removing the first 5 characters (<http)
)) AS ?newIRI # Name for the new variable
)
SERVICE <http://sparql.wikipathways.org/sparql> { #Connecting to the WikiPathways SPARQL endpoint.
?WP_pathway a wp:Pathway . #Stating a ?WP_pathway is indeed a pathway in the WikiPathways RDF .
?WP_pathway wp:organismName "Homo sapiens" . #Removing all PWs not for species Homo sapiens.
?WP_pathway dc:identifier ?PathwayID . #Query the identifier of the pathway in WPs.
?WP_pathway dc:title ?PathwayName . #Obtaining the name of the pathway.
?WP_gene a wp:Protein . #Stating that a ?WP_gene is a Protein DataNode (you could ommit this, to also get all DataNodes modeled as GeneProducts out, but query will take longer).
?WP_gene wp:bdbEntrezGene ?newIRI . #Connecting the previously queried "exact match" from WikiData to the NCBI/Entrez Gene ID in WPs.
?WP_gene dcterms:isPartOf ?WP_pathway . #Connecting the WP_gene to the WP_pathway.
}
OPTIONAL {?biomarker rdfs:label ?biomarkerLabel. #Create a label (aka name) for the biomarkers in WikiData, without using the service query.
FILTER(LANG(?biomarkerLabel) = "en").
}
OPTIONAL {?protein rdfs:label ?proteinLabel. #Create a label(aka name) for the proteins in WikiData, without using the service query.
FILTER(LANG(?proteinLabel) = "en").
}
}
ORDER BY DESC (?biomarkerLabel) #Order results for biomarkers

instruction: What are the most common height-to-width ratios of paintings?
annotated:
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?ratio (COUNT(?item) AS ?count) WHERE {
?item wdt:[property:instance of]/wdt:[property:subclass of]* wd:[entity:painting] .
?item p:[property:height]/psv:[property:height] [
wikibase:quantityAmount ?baseHeight;
wikibase:quantityUnit [
p:[property:conversion to SI unit]/psv:[property:conversion to SI unit] [
wikibase:quantityAmount ?unitHeight;
wikibase:quantityUnit wd:[entity:metre]
]
]
].
BIND(?baseHeight * ?unitHeight AS ?height).
?item p:[property:width]/psv:[property:width] [
wikibase:quantityAmount ?baseWidth;
wikibase:quantityUnit [
p:[property:conversion to SI unit]/psv:[property:conversion to SI unit] [
wikibase:quantityAmount ?unitWidth;
wikibase:quantityUnit wd:[entity:metre]
]
]
].
BIND(?baseWidth * ?unitWidth AS ?width).
BIND(?height / ?width AS ?r) .
BIND(IF(?r<0.5,"< 0.5",
IF(?r<0.6,"0.5 - 0.6",
IF(?r<0.7,"0.6 - 0.7",
IF(?r<0.8,"0.7 - 0.8",
IF(?r<0.9,"0.8 - 0.9",
IF(?r<1.0,"0.9 - 1.0",
IF(?r<1.1,"1.0 - 1.1",
IF(?r<1.2,"1.1 - 1.2",
IF(?r<1.3,"1.2 - 1.3",
IF(?r<1.4,"1.3 - 1.4",
IF(?r<1.5,"1.4 - 1.5", "> 1.5"))))))))))) AS ?ratio) .
}
GROUP BY ?ratio
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

FILTER(?dissolved > (?founded + "P200Y"^^xsd:duration))

instruction: List all Oxford University doctoral theses organized by their main topics.

annotated:

PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?deathYYYY_MM (COUNT(?gender) AS ?count) ?genderLabel WHERE {
?human wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human] .
?human wdt:[property:country of citizenship] wd:[entity:United Kingdom] .
?human wdt:[property:sex or gender] ?gender .
?human p:[property:date of death] [
a wikibase:BestRank ;
psv:[property:date of death] [
wikibase:timeValue ?dateOfDeath ;
wikibase:timePrecision ?precision
]
]
FILTER (?precision >= 10 ) # month precision or better
BIND(YEAR(?dateOfDeath) as ?year) .
BIND(MONTH(?dateOfDeath) as ?month) .
BIND ( IF(?month < 10, CONCAT("0",STR(?month) ), STR(?month)) AS ?MM)
BIND(CONCAT(STR(?year), "-", ?MM) as ?deathYYYY_MM).
FILTER (?year >= 2005)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}
GROUP BY ?deathYYYY_MM ?genderLabel

?item wdt:P569 ?dob .
?item p:P39 ?mp_stmt .
?mp_stmt ps:P39 ?mp .
?mp_stmt pq:P582 ?end_time .
OPTIONAL {
VALUES ?excluded_cause {wd:Q1787171 wd:Q35855188 wd:Q30580660 wd:Q35867887 wd:Q52084147} .
?mp_stmt pq:P1534 ?excluded_cause .
}
FILTER(!bound(?excluded_cause)) .
?mp_stmt pq:P1534 ?end_cause .
?mp wdt:P279 wd:Q16707842 .
?mp_next_parl wdt:P155 ?mp .
MINUS {?item wdt:P39 ?mp_next_parl} .
BIND (((?end_time - ?dob) / 365.24) AS ?age) .
FILTER(bound(?age)) .

LIMIT 200

SELECT ?wikidata ?wikidataLabel (?code as ?_iso3166) ?wikipedia (?wikidataAltLabel as ?alt) ?synonym ?wikidataDescription (?wikidataLabel as ?term) {
## Forcing particular query execution order
hint:Query hint:optimizer "None" .
## all ISO countries
?wikidata wdt:[property:ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code] ?code.
## Optional details about the countries like links to wikipaedia pages for each country to be presented in a seperate column

bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en".
## Selecting the prefered label
?wikidata skos:altLabel ?wikidataAltLabel ; rdfs:label ?wikidataLabel; schema:description ?wikidataDescription
}
## Making sure the RGI alphabets of the flags are not rendered as flags and they appear as simple alphabets by specifying the acceptable characters.
BIND (REPLACE(REPLACE(?wikidataAltLabel, "(, )?[-]{2}", ""), "^, ", "") AS ?synonym )
}
ORDER BY (?wikidataLabel)

query:
SELECT ?event ?eventLabel ?date
WHERE
{
# find events
?event wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q1190554.
# with a point in time or start date
OPTIONAL { ?event wdt:P585 ?date. }
OPTIONAL { ?event wdt:P580 ?date. }
# but at least one of those
FILTER(BOUND(?date) && DATATYPE(?date) = xsd:dateTime).
# not in the future, and not more than 31 days ago
BIND(NOW() - ?date AS ?distance).
FILTER(0 <= ?distance && ?distance < 31).
# and get a label as well
OPTIONAL
{
?event rdfs:label ?eventLabel.
FILTER(LANG(?eventLabel) = "en").
}
}
# limit to 10 results so we don't timeout
LIMIT 10

instruction: Find the Ordnance Survey Old Series preparatory drawings with georeferencer links.
query:
SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?itemLabel ?url ?georeferencing ?img ?bbox ?rgb (year(?year) AS ?layer)
WITH {
SELECT (xsd:integer(?colour) AS ?colour2) ?rgb WHERE {
wd:Q105849312 p:P527 ?stmt .
?stmt pq:P1545 ?colour .
?stmt pq:P465 ?rgb .
}
} AS %colours
WHERE {
?item wdt:P195 wd:Q7100888 . # OSD
?item p:P1332/psv:P1332/wikibase:geoLatitude ?nth .
?item p:P1333/psv:P1333/wikibase:geoLatitude ?sth .
?item p:P1334/psv:P1334/wikibase:geoLongitude ?east .
?item p:P1335/psv:P1335/wikibase:geoLongitude ?west .
?item wdt:P571 ?year .
BIND ((1 + floor ((year(?year) - 1789) * 2.0/3.0)) AS ?colour) .
BIND (xsd:integer(IF(?colour > 31, 31, ?colour)) AS ?colour2) .
INCLUDE %colours .
OPTIONAL {?item wdt:P18 ?img} .
?item wdt:P973 ?url .
?item wdt:P9361 ?georeferencing .
BIND(STRDT( CONCAT('LINESTRING (',
str(?west), ' ', str(?sth), ',',
str(?west), ' ', str(?nth), ',',
str(?east), ' ', str(?nth), ',',
str(?east), ' ', str(?sth), ',',
str(?west), ' ', str(?sth), ')' ), geo:wktLiteral) AS ?bbox) .
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}

PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?itemLabel ?url ?georeferencing ?img ?bbox ?rgb (year(?year) AS ?layer)
WITH {
SELECT (xsd:integer(?colour) AS ?colour2) ?rgb WHERE {
wd:[entity:blue-red colour progression] p:[property:has part(s)] ?stmt .
?stmt pq:[property:series ordinal] ?colour .
?stmt pq:[property:sRGB color hex triplet] ?rgb .
}
} AS %colours
WHERE {
?item wdt:[property:collection] wd:[entity:Ordnance Survey Drawings] . # OSD
?item p:[property:coordinates of northernmost point]/psv:[property:coordinates of northernmost point]/wikibase:geoLatitude ?nth .
?item p:[property:coordinates of southernmost point]/psv:[property:coordinates of southernmost point]/wikibase:geoLatitude ?sth .
?item p:[property:coordinates of easternmost point]/psv:[property:coordinates of easternmost point]/wikibase:geoLongitude ?east .
?item p:[property:coordinates of westernmost point]/psv:[property:coordinates of westernmost point]/wikibase:geoLongitude ?west .
?item wdt:[property:inception] ?year .
BIND ((1 + floor ((year(?year) - 1789) * 2.0/3.0)) AS ?colour) .
BIND (xsd:integer(IF(?colour > 31, 31, ?colour)) AS ?colour2) .
INCLUDE %colours .
OPTIONAL {?item wdt:[property:image] ?img} .
?item wdt:[property:described at URL] ?url .
?item wdt:[property:external georeferencing URL] ?georeferencing .
BIND(STRDT( CONCAT('LINESTRING (',
str(?west), ' ', str(?sth), ',',
str(?west), ' ', str(?nth), ',',
str(?east), ' ', str(?nth), ',',
str(?east), ' ', str(?sth), ',',
str(?west), ' ', str(?sth), ')' ), geo:wktLiteral) AS ?bbox) .
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
}

instruction: List the years when works were published that are used as examples for Swedish words.
query:
SELECT DISTINCT ?year (COUNT(?stated_in) AS ?count ) WHERE {
?l a ontolex:LexicalEntry;
dct:language ?language.
?language wdt:P218 'sv'.
?l wdt:P5831 ?example.
?l p:P5831 ?statement.
?statement prov:wasDerivedFrom ?refnode.
?refnode pr:P248 ?stated_in.
?stated_in wdt:P577 ?date.
BIND(str(YEAR(?date)) AS ?year)
}
GROUP BY ?year
ORDER BY ?year
annotated:
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX pr: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/reference/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?year (COUNT(?stated_in) AS ?count ) WHERE {
?l a ontolex:LexicalEntry;
dct:language ?language.
?language wdt:[property:ISO 639-1 code] 'sv'.
?l wdt:[property:usage example] ?example.
?l p:[property:usage example] ?statement.
?statement prov:wasDerivedFrom ?refnode.
?refnode pr:[property:stated in] ?stated_in.
?stated_in wdt:[property:publication date] ?date.
BIND(str(YEAR(?date)) AS ?year)
}
GROUP BY ?year
ORDER BY ?year

{ FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?diameterstmt pq:[property:criterion used] ?x } }

{ ?massstmt pq:[property:criterion used] wd:[entity:maximum] } UNION
{ FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?massstmt pq:[property:criterion used] ?x } }

instruction: What is the shortest rail route from Narvik to Singapore passing through Finland and Kazakhstan?

PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>

SELECT ?station ?stationLabel ?cds ?line ?layer WHERE {
{ SERVICE gas:service {
gas:program gas:gasClass "com.bigdata.rdf.graph.analytics.BFS" ; gas:in wd:[entity:Narvik] ; gas:target wd:[entity:Woodlands Train Checkpoint] ; gas:out ?station ; gas:out1 [] ; gas:out2 ?pred .
gas:program gas:linkType wdt:[property:adjacent station] . } }
FILTER(?station != wd:[entity:Narvik])
?pred p:[property:coordinate location]/psv:[property:coordinate location]/wikibase:geoLatitude ?lat1 ; p:[property:coordinate location]/psv:[property:coordinate location]/wikibase:geoLongitude ?lon1 .
?station p:[property:coordinate location]/psv:[property:coordinate location]/wikibase:geoLatitude ?lat2 ; p:[property:coordinate location]/psv:[property:coordinate location]/wikibase:geoLongitude ?lon2 .
BIND(CONCAT('LINESTRING(', STR(?lon1), ' ', STR(?lat1), ',', STR(?lon2), ' ', STR(?lat2), ')') AS ?str) . BIND(STRDT(?str, geo:wktLiteral) AS ?line)
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "bn,en". }
}

PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?itemLabel (count(?example) as ?example_count) (count(?property) as ?property_count) WHERE
{
?property p:[property:Wikidata property example] ?example . ?example ps:[property:Wikidata property example] ?item .
?item wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human] .
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }
} group by ?item ?itemLabel order by desc(?property_count)
